questions.name: #752 Formulaic Writing
questions.en:
A good starting place is to ______ writing as thinking.
Experienced writers don’t figure out what they want to say and then write it.
They write in order to figure out what they want to say.
Experienced writers develop theses in dialog with the body of the essay.
An initial characterization of the problem leads to a tentative thesis.
Then, drafting the body of the paper reveals thorny contradictions or critical areas of ambiguity, ______ the writer to revisit or expand the body of evidence and then refine the thesis based on that fresh look.
The revised thesis may require that body paragraphs be reordered and ______ to fit the emerging thesis.
Throughout the process, the thesis serves as an ______ point while the author wades through the morass of facts and ideas.
The writer continues to read to learn more about his or her issue and refines his or her ideas in response to what is learned.
The dialogue between thesis and body continues until the author is satisfied or the due date arrives, whatever comes first.
1. revolutionize , recharacterize , rehospitalize , resocialize
2. converting , prompting , diluting , computing
3. sophisticated , sustained , reshaped , penetrated
4. obvious , anchor , insightful , interesting
questions.full:
A good starting place is to ______ writing as thinking.
Experienced writers don’t figure out what they want to say and then write it.
They write in order to figure out what they want to say.
Experienced writers develop theses in dialog with the body of the essay.
An initial characterization of the problem leads to a tentative thesis.
Then, drafting the body of the paper reveals thorny contradictions or critical areas of ambiguity, ______ the writer to revisit or expand the body of evidence and then refine the thesis based on that fresh look.
The revised thesis may require that body paragraphs be reordered and ______ to fit the emerging thesis.
Throughout the process, the thesis serves as an ______ point while the author wades through the morass of facts and ideas.
The writer continues to read to learn more about his or her issue and refines his or her ideas in response to what is learned.
The dialogue between thesis and body continues until the author is satisfied or the due date arrives, whatever comes first.

1. revolutionize , recharacterize , rehospitalize , resocialize
2. converting , prompting , diluting , computing
3. sophisticated , sustained , reshaped , penetrated
4. obvious , anchor , insightful , interesting

答案:
1. recharacterize
2. prompting
3. reshaped
4. anchor

sense_groups.english: A good starting place is to recharacterize writing as thinking.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个好的起点是将写作重新定义为思考。

sense_groups.english: Experienced writers don’t figure out what they want to say and then write it.
sense_groups.chinese: 有经验的作者并不是先想好要说什么再写。

sense_groups.english: They write in order to figure out what they want to say.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们通过写作来弄清楚自己想说什么。

sense_groups.english: Experienced writers develop theses in dialog with the body of the essay.
sense_groups.chinese: 有经验的作者在论文主体部分的对话中发展论点。

sense_groups.english: An initial characterization of the problem leads to a tentative thesis.
sense_groups.chinese: 对问题的初步描述会形成一个暂定的论点。

sense_groups.english: Then, drafting the body of the paper reveals thorny contradictions or critical areas of ambiguity, prompting the writer to revisit or expand the body of evidence and then refine the thesis based on that fresh look.
sense_groups.chinese: 然后，起草论文主体部分会揭示棘手的矛盾或关键的模糊区域，促使作者重新审视或扩展证据主体，然后基于新的视角完善论点。

sense_groups.english: The revised thesis may require that body paragraphs be reordered and reshaped to fit the emerging thesis.
sense_groups.chinese: 修改后的论点可能要求重新排列和重塑主体段落，以适应新出现的论点。

sense_groups.english: Throughout the process, the thesis serves as an anchor point while the author wades through the morass of facts and ideas.
sense_groups.chinese: 在整个过程中，论点作为一个锚点，作者在事实和思想的泥沼中跋涉。

sense_groups.english: The writer continues to read to learn more about his or her issue and refines his or her ideas in response to what is learned.
sense_groups.chinese: 作者继续阅读以了解更多关于其问题，并根据所学内容完善自己的想法。

sense_groups.english: The dialogue between thesis and body continues until the author is satisfied or the due date arrives, whatever comes first.
sense_groups.chinese: 论点与主体之间的对话持续进行，直到作者满意或截止日期到来，以先到者为准。

questions.name: #753 Conclusion
questions.en:
A satisfying conclusion allows a reader to finish your paper with a clear understanding of the points you made and hopefully even a new ______ on the topic.
Any one paper might have a number of conclusions, but as the writer, you must consider who the readers are and the conclusions you want them to reach.
For example, is your reader relatively new to your topic?
If so, you may want to restate your main points for ______ as a way of starting the conclusion.
Don’t literally use the same sentence(s) as in your introduction, but come up with a comparable way of restating your thesis.
You’ll want to ______ conclude by showing that the judgment you have reached is, in fact, reasonable.
1. retrospective , respective , alternative , perspective
2. instance , emphasis , sale , service
3. grammatically , smoothly , energetically , rambunctiously
questions.full:
A satisfying conclusion allows a reader to finish your paper with a clear understanding of the points you made and hopefully even a new ______ on the topic.
Any one paper might have a number of conclusions, but as the writer, you must consider who the readers are and the conclusions you want them to reach.
For example, is your reader relatively new to your topic?
If so, you may want to restate your main points for ______ as a way of starting the conclusion.
Don’t literally use the same sentence(s) as in your introduction, but come up with a comparable way of restating your thesis.
You’ll want to ______ conclude by showing that the judgment you have reached is, in fact, reasonable.

1. retrospective , respective , alternative , perspective
2. instance , emphasis , sale , service
3. grammatically , smoothly , energetically , rambunctiously

答案:
1. perspective
2. emphasis
3. smoothly

sense_groups.english: A satisfying conclusion allows a reader to finish your paper with a clear understanding of the points you made and hopefully even a new perspective on the topic.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个令人满意的结论能让读者在读完你的论文后，清楚理解你所提出的观点，并且希望还能对这个话题有一个新的视角。

sense_groups.english: Any one paper might have a number of conclusions, but as the writer, you must consider who the readers are and the conclusions you want them to reach.
sense_groups.chinese: 任何一篇论文都可能有许多结论，但作为作者，你必须考虑读者是谁，以及你希望他们得出什么结论。

sense_groups.english: For example, is your reader relatively new to your topic?
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，你的读者是否对你的话题相对陌生？

sense_groups.english: If so, you may want to restate your main points for emphasis as a way of starting the conclusion.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果是这样，你可能希望为了强调而重述你的主要观点，以此作为结论的开头。

sense_groups.english: Don’t literally use the same sentence(s) as in your introduction, but come up with a comparable way of restating your thesis.
sense_groups.chinese: 不要照搬引言中的句子，而是想出一个类似的方式来重述你的论点。

sense_groups.english: You’ll want to smoothly conclude by showing that the judgment you have reached is, in fact, reasonable.
sense_groups.chinese: 你会希望顺利地得出结论，表明你所做出的判断实际上是合理的。

questions.name: #754 Types of Sources
questions.en:
Where do you go to find research materials?
That is more complicated for you than it was for students fifty years ago.
Before the Internet, as an undergraduate researcher, you were responsible for the sources ______ in your college or university’s library.
Under certain circumstances, materials could be ______ from other libraries through interlibrary loan services.
Things have changed.
As the saying goes, with great power comes great responsibility: the Internet, and all the information ______ with it, is now available to you as a researcher.
You are responsible for a lot more than is contained ______ the walls of the library.
This can feel overwhelming, so we will start by exploring the different types of publications you may encounter.
1. decipherable , saleable , conceivable , available
2. sustained , refrained , obtained , guaranteed
3. redeemed , disowned , associated , dissociated
4. within , off , besides , over
questions.full:
Where do you go to find research materials?
That is more complicated for you than it was for students fifty years ago.
Before the Internet, as an undergraduate researcher, you were responsible for the sources ______ in your college or university’s library.
Under certain circumstances, materials could be ______ from other libraries through interlibrary loan services.
Things have changed.
As the saying goes, with great power comes great responsibility: the Internet, and all the information ______ with it, is now available to you as a researcher.
You are responsible for a lot more than is contained ______ the walls of the library.
This can feel overwhelming, so we will start by exploring the different types of publications you may encounter.

1. decipherable , saleable , conceivable , available
2. sustained , refrained , obtained , guaranteed
3. redeemed , disowned , associated , dissociated
4. within , off , besides , over

答案:
1. available
2. obtained
3. associated
4. within

sense_groups.english: Where do you go to find research materials?
sense_groups.chinese: 你去哪里找研究资料？

sense_groups.english: That is more complicated for you than it was for students fifty years ago.
sense_groups.chinese: 这对你来说比五十年前的学生更复杂。

sense_groups.english: Before the Internet, as an undergraduate researcher, you were responsible for the sources available in your college or university’s library.
sense_groups.chinese: 在互联网出现之前，作为一名本科生研究员，你只能使用你所在大学图书馆里可用的资料。

sense_groups.english: Under certain circumstances, materials could be obtained from other libraries through interlibrary loan services.
sense_groups.chinese: 在某些情况下，可以通过馆际互借服务从其他图书馆获取资料。

sense_groups.english: Things have changed.
sense_groups.chinese: 情况已经变了。

sense_groups.english: As the saying goes, with great power comes great responsibility: the Internet, and all the information associated with it, is now available to you as a researcher.
sense_groups.chinese: 俗话说，能力越大，责任越大：互联网及其所有相关信息，现在作为研究人员的你都可以使用。

sense_groups.english: You are responsible for a lot more than is contained within the walls of the library.
sense_groups.chinese: 你要负责的远不止图书馆围墙内的内容。

sense_groups.english: This can feel overwhelming, so we will start by exploring the different types of publications you may encounter.
sense_groups.chinese: 这可能会让人不知所措，所以我们将从探索你可能遇到的不同类型的出版物开始。

questions.name: #755 Print Sources
questions.en:
Simply put, print sources are sources that have been published in printed format, such as many daily newspapers, magazines, academic or trade journals, books, government reports, etc. Just because an assignment requires the use of print sources doesn’t ______ mean that you must have access to the printed copy.
Many print sources can be accessed online.
The ______ feature of print sources is that they may be accessed in printed form, not that you have accessed them in printed form.
Regardless of how you access a print source, it is important to pay close attention to their credibility and ______ .
Just because an article appears in a print publication does not ______ its credibility.
Let’s now take a closer look at how analyzing the C.R.A.A.P. (currency, relevance, authority, accuracy, purpose) in a print source can help you determine its credibility and suitability.
1. necessarily , aggressively , momentously , indecisively
2. brainwashing , distinguishing , refurbishing , establishing
3. compatibility , conductibility , susceptibility , reliability
4. reassure , ensure , issue , ensue
questions.full:
Simply put, print sources are sources that have been published in printed format, such as many daily newspapers, magazines, academic or trade journals, books, government reports, etc. Just because an assignment requires the use of print sources doesn’t ______ mean that you must have access to the printed copy.
Many print sources can be accessed online.
The ______ feature of print sources is that they may be accessed in printed form, not that you have accessed them in printed form.
Regardless of how you access a print source, it is important to pay close attention to their credibility and ______ .
Just because an article appears in a print publication does not ______ its credibility.
Let’s now take a closer look at how analyzing the C.R.A.A.P. (currency, relevance, authority, accuracy, purpose) in a print source can help you determine its credibility and suitability.

1. necessarily , aggressively , momentously , indecisively
2. brainwashing , distinguishing , refurbishing , establishing
3. compatibility , conductibility , susceptibility , reliability
4. reassure , ensure , issue , ensue

答案:
1. necessarily
2. distinguishing
3. reliability
4. ensure

sense_groups.english: Simply put, print sources are sources that have been published in printed format,
sense_groups.chinese: 简单来说，印刷来源是指以印刷形式出版的来源，

sense_groups.english: such as many daily newspapers, magazines, academic or trade journals, books, government reports, etc.
sense_groups.chinese: 例如许多日报、杂志、学术或行业期刊、书籍、政府报告等。

sense_groups.english: Just because an assignment requires the use of print sources doesn’t necessarily mean that you must have access to the printed copy.
sense_groups.chinese: 仅仅因为作业要求使用印刷来源，并不一定意味着你必须拥有印刷副本。

sense_groups.english: Many print sources can be accessed online.
sense_groups.chinese: 许多印刷来源可以在线访问。

sense_groups.english: The distinguishing feature of print sources is that they may be accessed in printed form,
sense_groups.chinese: 印刷来源的显著特征是它们可以以印刷形式获取，

sense_groups.english: not that you have accessed them in printed form.
sense_groups.chinese: 而不是你已经以印刷形式获取了它们。

sense_groups.english: Regardless of how you access a print source,
sense_groups.chinese: 无论你如何获取印刷来源，

sense_groups.english: it is important to pay close attention to their credibility and reliability.
sense_groups.chinese: 密切关注它们的可信度和可靠性很重要。

sense_groups.english: Just because an article appears in a print publication does not ensure its credibility.
sense_groups.chinese: 仅仅因为一篇文章出现在印刷出版物中，并不能保证其可信度。

sense_groups.english: Let’s now take a closer look at how analyzing the C.R.A.A.P. (currency, relevance, authority, accuracy, purpose) in a print source
sense_groups.chinese: 现在让我们更仔细地看看如何分析印刷来源中的C.R.A.A.P.（时效性、相关性、权威性、准确性、目的）

sense_groups.english: can help you determine its credibility and suitability.
sense_groups.chinese: 可以帮助你确定其可信度和适用性。

questions.name: #756 Effective Management
questions.en:
Effective management involves four primary functions and related skill sets: planning, organizing, leading, and controlling.
Although there’s a logical sequence to the functions, in practice the four functions are often performed in a dynamic manner.
For example, a manager would need to develop or ______ a departmental or organizational plan prior to executing on it just as you would reference a map prior to ______ on a road trip.
The proverb ‘if you fail to prepare you are preparing to fail’ ______ the importance of this function.
However, just as when road or airport closures or other factors might cause you to change your original route, unanticipated internal or external factors might cause a manager to revisit and revise the original plan, requiring a change in the other functions and ______ tasks.
Thus, achieving organizational goals – arriving at your intended destination – requires ongoing management of the process and an understanding of the interrelationship of the four functions.
1. reference , occurrence , preference , conference
2. clicking , embarking , relying , bidding
3. underfeeds , undercounts , understates , underscores
4. enunciated , glaciated , appreciated , associated
questions.full:
Effective management involves four primary functions and related skill sets: planning, organizing, leading, and controlling.
Although there’s a logical sequence to the functions, in practice the four functions are often performed in a dynamic manner.
For example, a manager would need to develop or ______ a departmental or organizational plan prior to executing on it just as you would reference a map prior to ______ on a road trip.
The proverb ‘if you fail to prepare you are preparing to fail’ ______ the importance of this function.
However, just as when road or airport closures or other factors might cause you to change your original route, unanticipated internal or external factors might cause a manager to revisit and revise the original plan, requiring a change in the other functions and ______ tasks.
Thus, achieving organizational goals – arriving at your intended destination – requires ongoing management of the process and an understanding of the interrelationship of the four functions.

1. reference , occurrence , preference , conference
2. clicking , embarking , relying , bidding
3. underfeeds , undercounts , understates , underscores
4. enunciated , glaciated , appreciated , associated

答案:
1. reference
2. embarking
3. underscores
4. associated

sense_groups.english: Effective management involves four primary functions and related skill sets: planning, organizing, leading, and controlling.
sense_groups.chinese: 有效的管理涉及四个主要职能及相关技能：计划、组织、领导和控制。

sense_groups.english: Although there’s a logical sequence to the functions, in practice the four functions are often performed in a dynamic manner.
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管这些职能有逻辑顺序，但在实践中，这四个职能通常以动态的方式执行。

sense_groups.english: For example, a manager would need to develop or reference a departmental or organizational plan prior to executing on it just as you would reference a map prior to embarking on a road trip.
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，管理者需要在执行之前制定或参考部门或组织计划，就像你在开始公路旅行之前参考地图一样。

sense_groups.english: The proverb ‘if you fail to prepare you are preparing to fail’ underscores the importance of this function.
sense_groups.chinese: 谚语“如果你没有准备，就是在准备失败”强调了这一职能的重要性。

sense_groups.english: However, just as when road or airport closures or other factors might cause you to change your original route, unanticipated internal or external factors might cause a manager to revisit and revise the original plan, requiring a change in the other functions and associated tasks.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，就像道路或机场关闭或其他因素可能导致你改变原定路线一样，未预料到的内部或外部因素可能导致管理者重新审视和修改原计划，从而需要改变其他职能及相关任务。

sense_groups.english: Thus, achieving organizational goals – arriving at your intended destination – requires ongoing management of the process and an understanding of the interrelationship of the four functions.
sense_groups.chinese: 因此，实现组织目标——到达预期目的地——需要持续管理过程并理解四个职能之间的相互关系。

questions.name: #757 Organizing
questions.en:
Once plans are made, decisions must be made about how to best ______ the plans.
The organizing function involves deciding how the organization will be structured (by departments, matrix teams, job responsibilities, etc.).
Organizing involves assigning authority and responsibility to various departments, ______ resources across the organization, and defining how the activities of groups and individuals will be coordinated.
In the case of ThyssenKrupp AG, the management had to ______ how to support two very different sets of activities in order to achieve its long-term goal.
Management needed to continue steel production activities to provide continuity of funds as the emphasis gradually shifted to elevator production.
It also had to develop new skills and resources to build the company’s elevator capabilities.
A new organizational structure was needed that could support both business activities as one was downsized and the other built up.
1. couplement , supplement , implement , complement
2. duplicating , certificating , devastating , allocating
3. examine , determine , ermine , undermine
questions.full:
Once plans are made, decisions must be made about how to best ______ the plans.
The organizing function involves deciding how the organization will be structured (by departments, matrix teams, job responsibilities, etc.).
Organizing involves assigning authority and responsibility to various departments, ______ resources across the organization, and defining how the activities of groups and individuals will be coordinated.
In the case of ThyssenKrupp AG, the management had to ______ how to support two very different sets of activities in order to achieve its long-term goal.
Management needed to continue steel production activities to provide continuity of funds as the emphasis gradually shifted to elevator production.
It also had to develop new skills and resources to build the company’s elevator capabilities.
A new organizational structure was needed that could support both business activities as one was downsized and the other built up.

1. couplement , supplement , implement , complement
2. duplicating , certificating , devastating , allocating
3. examine , determine , ermine , undermine

答案:
1. implement
2. allocating
3. determine

sense_groups.english: Once plans are made, decisions must be made about how to best implement the plans.
sense_groups.chinese: 一旦制定了计划，就必须决定如何最好地实施这些计划。

sense_groups.english: The organizing function involves deciding how the organization will be structured (by departments, matrix teams, job responsibilities, etc.).
sense_groups.chinese: 组织职能涉及决定如何构建组织结构（按部门、矩阵团队、工作职责等）。

sense_groups.english: Organizing involves assigning authority and responsibility to various departments, allocating resources across the organization, and defining how the activities of groups and individuals will be coordinated.
sense_groups.chinese: 组织包括向各部门分配权力和责任、在整个组织内分配资源，以及定义如何协调团体和个人的活动。

sense_groups.english: In the case of ThyssenKrupp AG, the management had to determine how to support two very different sets of activities in order to achieve its long-term goal.
sense_groups.chinese: 以蒂森克虏伯公司为例，管理层必须确定如何支持两种截然不同的活动以实现其长期目标。

sense_groups.english: Management needed to continue steel production activities to provide continuity of funds as the emphasis gradually shifted to elevator production.
sense_groups.chinese: 管理层需要继续钢铁生产活动以提供资金连续性，同时重点逐渐转向电梯生产。

sense_groups.english: It also had to develop new skills and resources to build the company’s elevator capabilities.
sense_groups.chinese: 它还必须开发新的技能和资源来建立公司的电梯能力。

sense_groups.english: A new organizational structure was needed that could support both business activities as one was downsized and the other built up.
sense_groups.chinese: 需要一种新的组织结构来支持这两种业务活动，因为一个在缩减，另一个在壮大。

questions.name: #758 Environmental Factors
questions.en:
Weather, climate change, air quality, and natural disasters are all environmental factors.
Some industries are ______ at risk from changes in the natural environment, including manufacturing, agriculture, tourism and travel, and sports and entertainment.
Many pollution regulations limiting water and air pollution have been passed that affect the ______ of businesses.
Today, the impact of climate control is being debated in Congress, and organizations in many industries are ______ how this latest environmental threat will affect their operations.
Recently, Shell Oil spent more than $7 billion exploring parts of the Arctic Circle for oil – a ______ that was not possible before global warming increased drilling access in the area.
They have since cancelled this initiative due to a lack of results, as well as strong international ______ that it may cause further damage to an environmentally sensitive location.
1. necessarily , remotely , spatially , especially
2. deterioration , decoration , operation , transaction
3. discerning , concerning , concerned , discerned
4. vulture , motion , motive , venture
5. detests , digests , protests , contests
questions.full:
Weather, climate change, air quality, and natural disasters are all environmental factors.
Some industries are ______ at risk from changes in the natural environment, including manufacturing, agriculture, tourism and travel, and sports and entertainment.
Many pollution regulations limiting water and air pollution have been passed that affect the ______ of businesses.
Today, the impact of climate control is being debated in Congress, and organizations in many industries are ______ how this latest environmental threat will affect their operations.
Recently, Shell Oil spent more than $7 billion exploring parts of the Arctic Circle for oil – a ______ that was not possible before global warming increased drilling access in the area.
They have since cancelled this initiative due to a lack of results, as well as strong international ______ that it may cause further damage to an environmentally sensitive location.

1. necessarily , remotely , spatially , especially
2. deterioration , decoration , operation , transaction
3. discerning , concerning , concerned , discerned
4. vulture , motion , motive , venture
5. detests , digests , protests , contests

答案:
1. especially
2. operation
3. concerned
4. venture
5. protests

sense_groups.english: Weather, climate change, air quality, and natural disasters are all environmental factors.
sense_groups.chinese: 天气、气候变化、空气质量和自然灾害都是环境因素。

sense_groups.english: Some industries are especially at risk from changes in the natural environment, including manufacturing, agriculture, tourism and travel, and sports and entertainment.
sense_groups.chinese: 一些行业尤其面临自然环境变化的风险，包括制造业、农业、旅游业和体育娱乐业。

sense_groups.english: Many pollution regulations limiting water and air pollution have been passed that affect the operation of businesses.
sense_groups.chinese: 许多限制水和空气污染的法规已经通过，这些法规影响了企业的运营。

sense_groups.english: Today, the impact of climate control is being debated in Congress, and organizations in many industries are concerned how this latest environmental threat will affect their operations.
sense_groups.chinese: 如今，气候控制的影响正在国会中辩论，许多行业的组织都在关注这一最新的环境威胁将如何影响它们的运营。

sense_groups.english: Recently, Shell Oil spent more than $7 billion exploring parts of the Arctic Circle for oil – a venture that was not possible before global warming increased drilling access in the area.
sense_groups.chinese: 最近，壳牌石油花费超过70亿美元在北极圈部分地区勘探石油——在全球变暖增加了该地区钻探通道之前，这是一项不可能的事业。

sense_groups.english: They have since cancelled this initiative due to a lack of results, as well as strong international protests that it may cause further damage to an environmentally sensitive location.
sense_groups.chinese: 此后，由于缺乏成果以及强烈的国际抗议，他们取消了这一计划，抗议认为这可能会对环境敏感地区造成进一步损害。

questions.name: #759 One-dimensional Characters
questions.en:
Characters that lack internal conflict or multiple facets to their personality are often ______ as flat or one-dimensional characters.
This is often seen as a bad thing in a story, especially for first-time writers, when all of the characters are one-dimensional.
However, if there are one or two characters that are simplistic in nature for a reason, it may not be perceived as a negative ______ .

questions.name: #777 Skipping Stones
questions.en:
When physicist Lydéric Bocquet’s 7-year-old son asked him why a good throw makes a stone skip on a lake instead of ______ , Bocquet took the question as a challenge.
He has now produced a set of equations explaining the physics underlying the popular pastime.
Two key forces act on a skipping stone: gravity, which pulls it down, and lift, the reactive force of the water, which pushes the stone up each time it hits the ______ .
If the lift force is greater than the force of gravity then the stone bounces up; otherwise it sinks.
Bocquet’s physical model ______ out the conventional wisdom that the best skipping stones are flat and should be hurled nearly parallel to the water, fast and spinning.
The stone’s flatness maximizes the lift, as does its speed, which also provides energy to keep it bouncing along.
These are the same factors that keep a water-skier from sinking, Bocquet says.
Spin prevents the stone from tilting and hitting the water edge-first, just as fast rotations ______ a bicycle or a spinning top.
1. sinking , plunking , debunking , hiking
2. surface , efface , preface , boldface
3. hears , tears , fears , bears
4. commercialize , stabilize , nationalize , fertilize

sense_groups.chinese: Bocquet把这个提问当作一个挑战。

questions.name: #778 Speed of Earth
questions.en:
Our planet usually takes 24 hours to rotate on its ______ but not anymore.
On July 29, Earth’s full spin was 1.50 milliseconds shorter than 24 hours, which means Earth experienced its shortest day ever.
However, this wasn’t just a one-time fluke.
Earth has been in a hurry in recent years.
As per International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems (IERS), in 2020, Earth recorded 28 shortest days.
Earth’s faster rotation could affect our clocks.
The time that you and your mobile phone live by is ______ by Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
It is responsible for setting your time zone.
This time, also known as astronomical time, is ______ on how long it takes for Earth to complete one rotation.
As the rotation speed picks up, people who watch the Earth’s rotation and world’s clock for a living, will have to introduce a leap second to keep up with Earth’s pace and synchronize clocks with it.
1. axis , sundial , core , surface
2. delegated , addicted , dictated , rotated
3. dependent , focused , born , available

questions.name: #779 Polar Bears
questions.en:
Laidre and her colleagues analyzed genetic samples from polar bears that they tracked from 2015 to 2019, which they combined with data from previous studies.
In their first discovery, they found a few hundred polar bears in south-east Greenland are the most genetically ______ of their species.
While tracking these animals, the team further discovered this genetically-isolated group hunts via floating blocks of freshwater ice, broken off from glaciers, for about 250 days of the year, when sea ice has ______ .
This probably enables the bears to live in the area, which has no sea ice for considerably longer than other polar bear habitats.
While this suggests all polar bears are more ______ than we previously thought, glacial ice is largely limited to the animals around Greenland and Svalbard.
“Glacier ice may help small numbers of polar bears survive for longer periods under climate warming, and may be important to prevent extinction, but it is not available for the vast ______ of polar bears,” says Laidre.
“Climate action is the single most important thing for the future of polar bears.
Most polar bears in the Arctic depend on sea ice.”
1. articulated , correlated , isolated , overpopulated
2. pelted , belted , melted , felted
3. emollient , resilient , salient , redundant
4. minority , familiarity , singularity , majority

questions.name: #780 Dog's Breed
questions.en:

The findings suggest that stereotypes ______ with certain breeds have little basis.
Kathleen Morrill at the University of Massachusetts and her colleagues studied the DNA of more than 2000 dogs using a genome-wide analysis.
The team wanted to determine if any common genetic ______ could be linked to behaviors typically associated with particular dog types.
In other words, could genetics explain why Rottweilers often seem so aggressive or why Border collies are thought of as sociable?

After collecting all this information, the team focused their analysis on the differences between pure-bred and cross-bred dogs.

2. satisfactions , accommodations , variations , adjudications
3. entail , retail , detail , curtail

questions.name: #781 Painkillers
questions.en:
Fear that makes you vomit, the sting of a rejection, paralyzing grief – emotional pain can ______ in many physical symptoms.
And while writers and musicians have spun tales and crafted songs intertwining physical and emotional pain for centuries, scientists have found it more difficult to describe the relationship between the two.
Now, recent breakthroughs are shedding ______ on the shared mechanisms that underlie both kinds of pain, offering an explanation as to why one leads to the other and providing ______ for treating some of our most debilitating conditions.
While senses like vision and hearing have nerve pathways that can be traced from the eyes and ears to a distinct brain region, brain activity in response to pain is more complex.
It ______ thoughts and emotions, which is why a good book can lessen a toothache, for instance, or the pain from a hot probe hurts more when you feel sad.
1. manifest , infest , coerce , rifest
2. torchlight , lamp , light , beam
3. venues , retinues , revenues , avenues
4. incorporates , investigates , indicts , intertwines

questions.name: #783 Men and Calories
questions.en:
Winter may be seen as the time to fill up with comfort food, but in fact, the sunny summer months are when men eat more calories – unlike women.
The effect may ______ because sunlight makes the skin release an appetite-stimulating hormone called Ghrelin, says Carmit Levy at Tel Aviv University in Israel.
Levy and her team noticed the unexpected effect in experiments in mice that investigated mechanisms behind skin cancer, in which male animals ______ to UV light ate more food.
To see if humans do the same, the researchers used existing data on about 3000 people who had filled in detailed ______ questionnaires as part of the Israeli government’s regular national health and nutrition survey.
Between March and September, men consumed about 17 per cent more calories per day than they did during the rest of the year, while women’s food ______ stayed about the same.
1. resurrect , replace , occur , surprise
2. exposing , disposed , exposed , expose
3. technical , minor , dietary , scientific
4. outtake , uptake , undertake , intake

sense_groups.chinese: 作为以色列政府定期进行的全国健康和营养调查的一部分。

sense_groups.english: Between March and September,
sense_groups.chinese: 在三月到九月之间，

questions.name: #784 Longevity Diet
questions.en:
I have seen my future and it is full of beans, both literally and ______ .
As well as upping my bean count, there will be a lot of vegetables, no meat, long periods of hunger and hardly any alcohol.
But in return for this dietary discipline, my future will also be significantly longer and ______ .
I am 52 and, on my current diet, can expect to live another 29 years.
But if I change now, I could gain an extra decade and live in good health into my 90s.
This “longevity diet” isn’t just the latest fad, it is the product of more than a human lifespan of scientific research.
And it isn’t merely designed to prevent illness, but to actually slow down the ageing process – that’s the claim, anyway.
Of course, it is a no-brainer to say that our diets can alter our lifespans.
Worldwide, millions of people still die ______ every year from lack of calories and nutrients.
Meanwhile, an estimated 11 million die each year from too many calories and the wrong sort of nutrients.
1. significantly , intriguingly , mentally , metaphorically
2. sightlier , ghastlier , sprightlier , motlier
3. prematurely , precisely , professionally , presumably

questions.name: #785 Roman Concrete
questions.en:
Roman concrete, in many cases, has proven to be longer-lasting than its modern ______ ,which can deteriorate within decades.
Now, scientists behind a new study say they have uncovered the mystery ingredient that allowed the Romans to make their construction material so durable and build ______ structures in challenging places such as docks, sewers and earthquake zones.
They found that white chunks in the concrete, referred to as lime clasts, gave the concrete the ability to heal cracks that formed over time.
The white chunks previously had been ______ as evidence of sloppy mixing or poor-quality raw material.
With further study, the researchers concluded that lime clasts arose because of the use of quicklime (calcium oxide) – the most reactive, and dangerous, dry form of limestone – when mixing the concrete, rather than or in addition to slaked lime.
Additional analysis of the concrete showed that the lime clasts formed ______ extreme temperatures expected from the use of quicklime, and “hot mixing” was key to the concrete’s durable nature.
1. flocculent , equivalent , ambivalent , rambunctious
2. amplified , evasive , elaborate , equivocal
3. overlooked , overdeveloped , oversaw , overrefined
4. in , within , off , at

questions.name: #786 Low-income Countries
questions.en:
Periods of extremely hot weather cost the global economy an estimated $16 trillion between 1992 and 2013, while ______ the poorest countries four times as hard as the richest ones.
“Our work reveals that we have ______ both the costs of climate change so far and how sensitive our economy is at present to climate variations,” says Justin Mankin at Dartmouth University in New Hampshire.

This is partly because many low-income countries are in the tropics and have a hotter climate to begin with.
New data on economic growth allowed Mankin and Christopher Callahan, also at Dartmouth College, to look at the impact of extreme heat at a regional level and use models to fill in the data in parts of Africa and Asia where figures were missing.

questions.name: #787 Global Warming
questions.en:

sense_groups.english: It is less clear whether these benefits carry over to non-musical tasks or to non-musicians who are learning to play an instrument, and how these changes might actually be seen in the brain.
sense_groups.chinese: 目前尚不清楚这些益处是否适用于非音乐任务或正在学习乐器的非音乐家，以及这些变化如何在大脑中实际显现。

sense_groups.english: Theodore Zanto at the University of California, San Francisco, and his colleagues, randomly assigned a group of 47 non-musicians, aged between 60 and 79, to play either a tablet-based musical rhythm training game, which emulates learning to hit a drum in time with a teacher, or a word search game for eight weeks.
sense_groups.chinese: 加州大学旧金山分校的西奥多·赞托及其同事随机将47名年龄在60至79岁之间的非音乐家分为两组，一组玩平板电脑上的音乐节奏训练游戏（该游戏模拟了跟着老师及时打鼓的学习过程），另一组玩单词搜索游戏，持续八周。

sense_groups.english: At the start and end of the eight weeks, participants took a short-term memory test to measure their ability to remember a face they saw seconds before.
sense_groups.chinese: 在八周的开始和结束时，参与者接受了短期记忆测试，以衡量他们记住几秒钟前看到的面孔的能力。

sense_groups.english: Only the group who played the rhythm training game showed an improvement on their initial scores – of around 4 per cent.
sense_groups.chinese: 只有玩节奏训练游戏的组在初始分数上有所提高——大约提高了4%。

questions.name: #789 Brainpower
questions.en:
You may have heard that humans only use 10 percent of their brain power, and that if you could ______ the rest of your brainpower, you could do so much more.
You could become a super genius, or acquire psychic powers like mind reading and telekinesis.
However, there is a powerful body of evidence ______ the 10 percent myth.
Scientists have consistently shown that humans use their entire brain throughout each day.
Despite the evidence, the 10 percent myth has inspired many references in the cultural imagination.
Films like "Limitless" and "Lucy" ______ protagonists who develop godlike powers thanks to drugs that unlock the previously ______ 90 percent of the brain.
A 2013 study showed that about 65 percent of Americans believe the trope, and a 1998 study showed that a full third of psychology majors, who focus on the workings of the brain, fell for it.
1. unnerve , unleash , underlie , uncover
2. debunking , diluting , colliding , swerving
3. convict , depict , constrict , restrict
4. inaccessible , insusceptible , insupportable , interpersonal

sense_groups.english: Scientists have consistently shown that humans use their entire brain throughout each day.

questions.name: #790 Volcanic Eruptions
questions.en:
Volcanic eruptions provide routes for material deep beneath Earth's surface to escape to the surface.
They also allow a world to ______ its heat.
Active volcanoes on Earth and Venus are fed by subsurface molten rock.
On Earth, the lava comes up from the mantle (which is the layer under the surface).
Once there's enough molten rock — called magma — and enough pressure on it, a volcanic eruption ______ .
In many volcanoes, the magma rises up through a central tube or "throat," and ______ out the top of the mountain.
Volcanic activity can be fairly quiet, or it can be quite ______ .
In a very active flow, clouds of gas may come rolling out of the volcanic caldera.
These are quite deadly because they're hot and moving fast, and the heat and gas can kill someone very quickly.
1. invent , dent , prevent , vent
2. occurs , concurs , recurs , incurs
3. merges , converges , submerges , emerges
4. qualified , equivalent , explosive , tranquil

sense_groups.english: In many volcanoes, the magma rises up through a central tube or "throat," and emerges out the top of the mountain.

questions.name: #791 Acid Rain
questions.en:
Acid deposition can be caused by natural sources such as volcanoes, but it is mainly caused by the ______ of sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxide during fossil fuel combustion.
When these gases are discharged into the atmosphere, they react with the water, oxygen, and other gases already present there to form sulfuric acid, ammonium nitrate, and nitric acid.
These acids then ______ over large areas because of wind patterns and fall back to the ground as acid rain or other forms of precipitation.
The gases most responsible for acid deposition are a byproduct of electric power generation and the burning of coal.
As ______ , man-made acid deposition began becoming a significant issue during the Industrial Revolution.
Although it was discovered in the 1800s, acid deposition did not gain significant public attention until the 1960s, and the term "acid rain" was coined in 1972.
Public attention ______ increased in the 1970s when the "New York Times" published reports about problems occurring in the Hubbard Brook Experimental Forest in New Hampshire.
1. release , lease , tease , cease
2. dispose , disapprove , disperse , disposition
3. saying , part , evidence , such
4. inadvertently , geometrically , comprehensively , further
questions.full:

sense_groups.english: but it is mainly caused by the release of sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxide during fossil fuel combustion.
sense_groups.chinese: 但主要是由化石燃料燃烧过程中释放的二氧化硫和氮氧化物引起的。

sense_groups.english: When these gases are discharged into the atmosphere,

sense_groups.english: As such, man-made acid deposition began becoming a significant issue during the Industrial Revolution.
sense_groups.chinese: 因此，人为酸沉降在工业革命期间开始成为一个重要问题。

sense_groups.english: Although it was discovered in the 1800s,

questions.name: #792 Drought
questions.en:
Every year as summer approaches, areas around the world grow concerned about seasonal drought.
Throughout the winter, many places ______ precipitation and the snowpack to prepare for what the warmer, drier months may bring.
In addition, there are areas where drought is a regular year-to-year ______ that lasts longer than just the summer.
From hot deserts to the freezing poles, drought is something that affects plants, animals, and people worldwide.
Usually, drought is talked about in one of two perspectives — meteorological and hydrological.
A drought in ______ of meteorology takes into account deficiencies in measured precipitation.
Each year's measurements are then compared to what is determined as a "normal" amount of precipitation and drought is determined from there.
For hydrologists, droughts are monitored by checking stream flow and lake, reservoir, and ______ water levels.
Precipitation is also considered here as it contributes to the water levels.
1. senate , monitor , compete , reveal
2. reference , currency , occurrence , conference
3. possession , terms , memory , violation
4. troffer , aquifer , roofer , hoofer

sense_groups.english: Every year as summer approaches, areas around the world grow concerned about seasonal drought.
sense_groups.chinese: 每年夏天临近时，世界各地都会对季节性干旱感到担忧。

sense_groups.english: Throughout the winter, many places monitor precipitation and the snowpack to prepare for what the warmer, drier months may bring.
sense_groups.chinese: 整个冬季，许多地方监测降水和积雪，为可能到来的更温暖、更干燥的月份做准备。

sense_groups.english: In addition, there are areas where drought is a regular year-to-year occurrence that lasts longer than just the summer.
sense_groups.chinese: 此外，有些地区的干旱是每年都会发生的常态，持续时间超过夏季。

sense_groups.english: From hot deserts to the freezing poles, drought is something that affects plants, animals, and people worldwide.
sense_groups.chinese: 从炎热的沙漠到寒冷的极地，干旱影响着全世界的植物、动物和人类。

sense_groups.english: Usually, drought is talked about in one of two perspectives — meteorological and hydrological.
sense_groups.chinese: 通常，干旱从两个角度讨论——气象学和水文学。

sense_groups.english: A drought in terms of meteorology takes into account deficiencies in measured precipitation.
sense_groups.chinese: 从气象学角度，干旱考虑的是实测降水量的不足。

sense_groups.english: Each year's measurements are then compared to what is determined as a "normal" amount of precipitation and drought is determined from there.
sense_groups.chinese: 然后将每年的测量值与所谓的“正常”降水量进行比较，从而判断是否干旱。

sense_groups.english: For hydrologists, droughts are monitored by checking stream flow and lake, reservoir, and aquifer water levels.
sense_groups.chinese: 对于水文学家，干旱通过检查河流流量以及湖泊、水库和含水层的水位来监测。

sense_groups.english: Precipitation is also considered here as it contributes to the water levels.
sense_groups.chinese: 这里也考虑降水，因为它影响水位。

questions.name: #793 Blind People
questions.en:
A person who is born blind has dreams but doesn't see images.
Dreams could include sounds, ______ information, odors, flavors, and feelings.
On the other hand, if a person has sight and then loses it, dreams may include images.
People who have impaired vision do see in their dreams.
The appearance of objects in dreams depends on the type and history of blindness.
Mostly, the vision in dreams is ______ to the range of vision the person has had throughout life.
For example, someone who has color blindness won't suddenly see new colors while dreaming.
A person whose vision degraded over time might dream with the perfect clarity of earlier days or might dream at present ______ .
Sighted people who wear corrective lenses have much the same experience.
A dream may be perfectly in focus or not.
It's all based on experience gathered over time.
Someone who is blind yet perceives flashes of light and color from Charles Bonnet syndrome may ______ these experiences into dreams.
1. volatile , tactile , versatile , fertile
2. comparable , interchangeable , incomparable , imperturbable
3. agility , acuity , compatibility , tenuity
4. institute , insure , incorporate , inhabit

sense_groups.english: A person who is born blind has dreams but doesn't see images.
sense_groups.chinese: 天生失明的人会做梦，但看不到图像。

sense_groups.english: Dreams could include sounds, tactile information, odors, flavors, and feelings.
sense_groups.chinese: 梦境可能包括声音、触觉信息、气味、味道和感觉。

sense_groups.english: On the other hand, if a person has sight and then loses it, dreams may include images.
sense_groups.chinese: 另一方面，如果一个人原本有视力后来失明，梦境中可能包含图像。

sense_groups.english: A person whose vision degraded over time might dream with the perfect clarity of earlier days or might dream at present acuity .

sense_groups.chinese: 因查尔斯·邦内综合征而感知到闪光和色彩的盲人可能会将这些体验融入梦境。

questions.name: #794 Thermal Equilibrium
questions.en:
The distinction between heat and temperature is ______ but very important.
Heat refers to the transfer of energy between systems (or bodies), whereas temperature is determined by the energy ______ within a singular system (or body).
In other words, heat is energy, while temperature is a measure of energy.
Adding heat will increase a body's temperature while removing heat will lower the temperature, thus changes in temperature are the result of the presence of heat, or ______ , the lack of heat.
Particles have more energy at higher temperatures, and as this energy is transferred from one system to another, the fast-moving particles will collide with slower moving particles.
As they collide, the faster particle will transfer some of its energy to the slower particle, and the process will continue until all the particles are ______ at the same rate.
This is called thermal equilibrium.
1. subtle , spittle , brittle , dismantle
2. retained , sustained , contained , remained
3. scarcely , conversely , sparsely , diversely
4. dictating , devastating , operating , fascinating

sense_groups.english: Adding heat will increase a body's temperature while removing heat will lower the temperature, thus changes in temperature are the result of the presence of heat, or conversely, the lack of heat.
sense_groups.chinese: 增加热量会升高物体的温度，而移除热量会降低温度，因此温度的变化是热量存在或相反地热量缺乏的结果。

sense_groups.english: Particles have more energy at higher temperatures, and as this energy is transferred from one system to another, the fast-moving particles will collide with slower moving particles.
sense_groups.chinese: 在较高温度下，粒子具有更多能量，当这些能量从一个系统转移到另一个系统时，快速运动的粒子会与较慢运动的粒子碰撞。

sense_groups.english: As they collide, the faster particle will transfer some of its energy to the slower particle, and the process will continue until all the particles are operating at the same rate.
sense_groups.chinese: 当它们碰撞时，较快的粒子会将其部分能量传递给较慢的粒子，这个过程会持续，直到所有粒子都以相同的速率运动。

sense_groups.english: This is called thermal equilibrium.
sense_groups.chinese: 这被称为热平衡。

sense_groups.english: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an international financial organization made up of 190 member countries.
sense_groups.chinese: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）是一个由190个成员国组成的国际金融机构。

sense_groups.english: Headquartered in Washington, D.C., the IMF works to foster global monetary cooperation, secure financial stability, facilitate fair international trade, promote high employment and sustainable economic growth, and reduce poverty around the world.
sense_groups.chinese: 总部设在华盛顿特区的IMF致力于促进全球货币合作、确保金融稳定、促进公平国际贸易、推动高就业和可持续经济增长，并减少世界各地的贫困。

sense_groups.english: The IMF is both accountable to and governed by its near-global membership of 190 countries.
sense_groups.chinese: IMF既对其近全球性的190个成员国负责，也受其治理。

sense_groups.english: The Board of Governors is the highest decision-making body of the IMF.
sense_groups.chinese: 理事会（Board of Governors）是IMF的最高决策机构。

sense_groups.english: It consists of one governor and one alternate governor from each member country.
sense_groups.chinese: 它由每个成员国的一名理事和一名副理事组成。

sense_groups.english: The governor is appointed by the member country and is usually the minister of finance or the head of the central bank.
sense_groups.chinese: 理事由成员国任命，通常是财政部长或央行行长。

sense_groups.english: The day-to-day work of the IMF is overseen by its 24-member Executive Board, which oversees the entire membership and is supported by IMF staff.
sense_groups.chinese: IMF的日常工作由其24名成员组成的执行董事会（Executive Board）监督，该董事会监督全体成员，并得到IMF工作人员的支持。

sense_groups.english: The Managing Director is the head of the IMF staff and Chair of the Executive Board and is assisted by four Deputy Managing Directors.
sense_groups.chinese: 总裁（Managing Director）是IMF工作人员的首脑和执行董事会的主席，由四位副总裁协助。

sense_groups.english: The primary functions of the IMF are lending, economic condition surveillance, and technical assistance to member countries.
sense_groups.chinese: IMF的主要职能是向成员国提供贷款、经济状况监测和技术援助。

questions.name: #798 Amazon River
questions.en:
The Amazon is undeniably one of the world’s greatest rivers.
It is the largest river by ______ , and its basin is home to the Amazon Rainforest, the world’s richest and most-varied biological reservoir.
The Amazon might also be the world’s longest river — ______ on whom you ask.

2. focusing , turning , depending , pending
3. inserted , deserted , asserted , exserted
4. keepsake , sake , forsake , namesake

1. state , subject , name , volume

2. depending

sense_groups.english: The Amazon is undeniably one of the world’s greatest rivers.
sense_groups.chinese: 亚马逊河无疑是世界上最伟大的河流之一。

sense_groups.english: It is the largest river by volume,
sense_groups.chinese: 它是水量最大的河流，

sense_groups.english: and its basin is home to the Amazon Rainforest, the world’s richest and most-varied biological reservoir.
sense_groups.chinese: 其流域拥有亚马逊雨林，这是世界上最丰富、最多样的生物宝库。

sense_groups.english: The Amazon might also be the world’s longest river — depending on whom you ask.
sense_groups.chinese: 亚马逊河可能也是世界上最长的河流——这取决于你问谁。

sense_groups.english: Most scientists believe the South American river is at least 4,000 miles (6,400 km) long — still shorter than the Nile, which is widely held to be the world’s longest river at about 4,132 miles (6,650 km).

sense_groups.chinese: 然而，其他人则断言亚马逊河实际上要长得多。

sense_groups.english: One would think a definitive measurement would be easy to obtain with modern technology; if its namesake online company can deliver cans of unicorn meat by drone, then determining the Amazon’s length shouldn’t be too hard.
sense_groups.chinese: 人们会认为用现代技术很容易获得确切的测量结果；如果与其同名的在线公司能用无人机运送独角兽肉罐头，那么确定亚马逊河的长度应该不会太难。

sense_groups.english: However, it’s actually proven very difficult.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，事实证明这非常困难。

questions.name: #802 Acclimatization
questions.en:
Acclimatization refers to any of the numerous gradual, long-term responses of an organism to changes in its environment.
Such responses are more or less habitual and reversible should environmental conditions ______ to an earlier state.
The numerous sudden changes that ______ rapid and short-term responses via the nervous and hormonal systems are not examples of acclimatization.
An individual organism can regulate its internal processes rapidly to sustain itself within the usual range of environmental changes that it ______ hourly or daily.
But this rapid regulation, or homeostasis, is limited in its operation to a small range of environmental variations.
Homeostatic regulation usually cannot meet effectively large environmental changes such as those that would allow a plant or animal living in the warmth of summer to ______ in the cold of winter.
As summer wanes, organisms change their substance and their habits in seeming anticipation of the coming winter.
This gradual adjustment to conditions is acclimatization.
1. denounce , revert , review , renounce
2. prioritize , evoke , possess , ventilate
3. encounters , counters , reimburses , succumbs
4. conjunction , cite , construct , function

But this rapid regulation, or homeostasis, is limited in its operation to a small range of environmental variations.
Homeostatic regulation usually cannot meet effectively large environmental changes such as those that would allow a plant or animal living in the warmth of summer to ______ in the cold of winter.
As summer wanes, organisms change their substance and their habits in seeming anticipation of the coming winter.
This gradual adjustment to conditions is acclimatization.

1. denounce , revert , review , renounce
2. prioritize , evoke , possess , ventilate
3. encounters , counters , reimburses , succumbs
4. conjunction , cite , construct , function

2. evoke
3. encounters
4. function

sense_groups.english: Such responses are more or less habitual and reversible should environmental conditions revert to an earlier state.
sense_groups.chinese: 这些响应或多或少是习惯性的，并且如果环境条件恢复到之前的状态，它们是可逆的。

sense_groups.chinese: 那些通过神经和激素系统引发快速短期响应的众多突然变化，不属于适应的例子。

questions.name: #820 Sense of Number
questions.en:

All these numbers can have an evolutionary significance, and if a creature can recognize them, this could afford an adaptive advantage.
Bees can count dots one at a time while crawling over them; they might use this process to ______ flowers by the number of petals.
A sense of number could also be valuable for surviving encounters with other creatures.
Small fish join the largest shoal because it reduces the risk of predation.
Numerical abilities are also important for navigation: honeybees count landmarks sequentially, one at a time, as a way of estimating the distance between the hive and a food source.
This enables them to ______ their route back home.
1. discourse , coarse , recourse , course
2. need , market , body , awareness

4. slot , clot , plot , blot

questions.name: #821 Spain’s Law
questions.en:
Cigarette butts are the poster child of pollution and litter, and now, Spain is taking action to ______ this serious problem.

questions.name: #822 Male Chicks
questions.en:

As such, these undesirable byproducts of egg production may be killed through gassing.

But a groundbreaking development could have major implications for animal welfare in the poultry industry, perhaps finally putting an end to the ______ of an estimated seven billion male chicks each year shortly after they hatch due to their lack of commercial value.
Israeli researchers have created gene-edited hens that lay eggs from which only female chicks hatch.

4. breed , deed , greed , creed

sense_groups.english: Male chicks have been dealt a bad hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们不下蛋，而且通常比母鸡的肉少，

sense_groups.chinese: 这意味着它们不仅没用，还是农民的负担。

questions.name: #823 Transparent Solar Cells
questions.en:
No matter how sustainable, eco-friendly, and clean sources of energy they are, conventional solar panels require a large setup area and heavy initial investment.
Due to these ______ , it’s hard to introduce them in urban areas especially neighborhoods with lots of apartment blocks or shops.
But now researchers have created transparent solar panels which they claim could be used as power-generating windows in our homes.
In order to generate power from sunlight, solar cells ______ on a solar panel are required to absorb radiation from the sun.
Therefore, they cannot allow sunlight to completely pass through them.
Transparent luminescent solar concentrators are capable of selectively absorbing invisible solar radiation including infrared and UV lights, and letting the rest of the visible rays pass through them.
In other words, these devices are transparent to the human eye but still absorb a ______ of the solar light which they can then convert into electricity.
1. certifications , imitations , implications , limitations
2. embedded , boarded , comprehended , deleted
3. contraction , transaction , fraction , friction
questions.full:

sense_groups.chinese: 透明发光太阳能聚光器能够选择性地吸收包括红外线和紫外线在内的不可见太阳辐射，

sense_groups.english: and letting the rest of the visible rays pass through them.

questions.name: #824 Climate Migration

The biggest driver of destruction is how we use the land and the sea.
This includes the ______ of land cover such as forests and other natural habitats for agricultural and urban use.
And agricultural expansion is the main driver behind deforestation, with animal farming being a particular driver of forest degradation and forest biodiversity loss.
The natural world is also affected by the climate crisis.
Species and ecosystems around the world, especially the most ______ ones, are affected by the rise of greenhouse gas emissions.
Mankind’s emissions of greenhouse gases are warming up the atmosphere and ______ , everything on Earth.

1. disorienting , meditating , resuscitating , devastating
2. natural , liberal , conjectural , multicultural
3. conversion , division , confusion , convulsion
4. transferable , wealthy , vulnerable , arable
5. intermittently , subsequently , concurrently , indifferently

答案:
1. devastating
2. natural
3. conversion
4. vulnerable
5. subsequently

sense_groups.english: Some 66 million years ago, a meteor crashed into the coast of Mexico’s Yucatan Peninsula, marking the end of the age of dinosaurs.
sense_groups.chinese: 大约6600万年前，一颗流星撞击了墨西哥尤卡坦半岛的海岸，标志着恐龙时代的结束。

sense_groups.english: It was a mass extinction event and it was devastating.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是一次大规模灭绝事件，而且是毁灭性的。

sense_groups.english: A mass extinction is a short period of geological time in which a high percentage of biodiversity, or distinct species dies out.
sense_groups.chinese: 大规模灭绝是指地质时期中，高比例的生物多样性或独特物种灭绝的短暂时期。

sense_groups.english: Unlike previous extinction events that were caused by natural phenomena, the sixth mass extinction is driven by human activity.
sense_groups.chinese: 与之前由自然现象引起的灭绝事件不同，第六次大规模灭绝是由人类活动驱动的。

sense_groups.english: The biggest driver of destruction is how we use the land and the sea.
sense_groups.chinese: 破坏的最大驱动力是我们如何使用土地和海洋。

sense_groups.english: This includes the conversion of land cover such as forests and other natural habitats for agricultural and urban use.
sense_groups.chinese: 这包括将森林和其他自然栖息地等土地覆盖转化为农业和城市用途。

sense_groups.english: And agricultural expansion is the main driver behind deforestation, with animal farming being a particular driver of forest degradation and forest biodiversity loss.
sense_groups.chinese: 农业扩张是森林砍伐的主要驱动力，而畜牧业更是森林退化和森林生物多样性丧失的一个特定驱动因素。

sense_groups.english: The natural world is also affected by the climate crisis.
sense_groups.chinese: 自然界也受到气候危机的影响。

sense_groups.english: Species and ecosystems around the world, especially the most vulnerable ones, are affected by the rise of greenhouse gas emissions.
sense_groups.chinese: 世界各地的物种和生态系统，尤其是最脆弱的那些，都受到温室气体排放增加的影响。

sense_groups.english: Mankind’s emissions of greenhouse gases are warming up the atmosphere and subsequently, everything on Earth.
sense_groups.chinese: 人类排放的温室气体正在使大气变暖，进而影响地球上的万物。

questions.name: #826 Dolphins
questions.en:
Alzheimer’s is the most common cause of dementia.
It affects memory, thinking, and behavior and it’s serious enough to ______ with daily life.
The main risk factor is increasing age, and most people with Alzheimer’s are 65 or older.
Until now, this was thought to be a human-only disease, but this may not be the case.
The brains of three species of dolphins ______ along the coast of Scotland have shown the classic markers of human Alzheimer’s disease – ______ that dolphins too may be plagued by the disease.
The researchers still don’t know why this brain ______ could be happening in odontocetes, but it could explain why some groups of whales, dolphins, and porpoises run aground in shallow water.
1. interfere , engage , comply , associate
2. commanded , stranded , unbranded , expanded
3. inseminating , tinting , hinting , legitimating

questions.full:
Alzheimer’s is the most common cause of dementia.
It affects memory, thinking, and behavior and it’s serious enough to ______ with daily life.
The main risk factor is increasing age, and most people with Alzheimer’s are 65 or older.
Until now, this was thought to be a human-only disease, but this may not be the case.
The brains of three species of dolphins ______ along the coast of Scotland have shown the classic markers of human Alzheimer’s disease – ______ that dolphins too may be plagued by the disease.

1. interfere , engage , comply , associate
2. commanded , stranded , unbranded , expanded
3. inseminating , tinting , hinting , legitimating
4. tissue , area , degeneration , activity

答案:
1. interfere
2. stranded
3. hinting
4. degeneration

sense_groups.english: Alzheimer’s is the most common cause of dementia.
sense_groups.chinese: 阿尔茨海默病是痴呆症最常见的原因。

sense_groups.english: It affects memory, thinking, and behavior
sense_groups.chinese: 它影响记忆、思维和行为，

sense_groups.english: and it’s serious enough to interfere with daily life.
sense_groups.chinese: 并且严重到干扰日常生活。

sense_groups.english: The main risk factor is increasing age,
sense_groups.chinese: 主要风险因素是年龄增长，

sense_groups.english: and most people with Alzheimer’s are 65 or older.
sense_groups.chinese: 大多数阿尔茨海默病患者年龄在65岁及以上。

sense_groups.english: Until now, this was thought to be a human-only disease,
sense_groups.chinese: 直到现在，这被认为是一种人类独有的疾病，

sense_groups.english: but this may not be the case.
sense_groups.chinese: 但事实可能并非如此。

sense_groups.english: The brains of three species of dolphins stranded along the coast of Scotland
sense_groups.chinese: 在苏格兰海岸搁浅的三种海豚的大脑

sense_groups.english: have shown the classic markers of human Alzheimer’s disease
sense_groups.chinese: 显示出人类阿尔茨海默病的典型标志，

sense_groups.english: – hinting that dolphins too may be plagued by the disease.
sense_groups.chinese: 暗示海豚也可能受到这种疾病的困扰。

sense_groups.english: The researchers still don’t know why this brain degeneration could be happening in odontocetes,
sense_groups.chinese: 研究人员仍然不知道为什么这种脑部退化会发生在齿鲸类动物身上，

sense_groups.english: but it could explain why some groups of whales, dolphins, and porpoises run aground in shallow water.
sense_groups.chinese: 但这可以解释为什么一些鲸鱼、海豚和鼠海豚群体会在浅水区搁浅。

questions.name: #827 ClearFarm
questions.en:
ClearFarm will be the first platform to provide non-stop, real-time information on animal welfare.
Consumers and producers will be able to view information from every single animal on the farm, every single day of the year.
The approach ______ on precision livestock farming, or PLF, which involves using modern tools like sensors, AI data processing, and automation to gather data and optimize farm output.

questions.full:
ClearFarm will be the first platform to provide non-stop, real-time information on animal welfare.
Consumers and producers will be able to view information from every single animal on the farm, every single day of the year.
The approach ______ on precision livestock farming, or PLF, which involves using modern tools like sensors, AI data processing, and automation to gather data and optimize farm output.
The idea is to strap wearable sensors to the animals that ______ collect data on activity, diet, and overall health.
Not only will farmers be able to ______ quickly and more responsibly when the system detects a health problem in one of their livestock, but the system will also open a window into the real-time comfort, emotional state, and behavior of these animals.

sense_groups.english: ClearFarm will be the first platform
sense_groups.chinese: ClearFarm将成为第一个平台

sense_groups.english: to provide non-stop, real-time information on animal welfare.
sense_groups.chinese: 提供不间断、实时的动物福利信息。

sense_groups.english: Consumers and producers will be able to view information
sense_groups.chinese: 消费者和生产商将能够查看信息

sense_groups.english: from every single animal on the farm, every single day of the year.
sense_groups.chinese: 来自农场每一只动物，一年中的每一天。

sense_groups.english: The approach hinges on precision livestock farming, or PLF,
sense_groups.chinese: 该方法依赖于精准畜牧业（PLF），

sense_groups.english: which involves using modern tools like sensors, AI data processing, and automation
sense_groups.chinese: 它涉及使用传感器、人工智能数据处理和自动化等现代工具

sense_groups.english: to gather data and optimize farm output.
sense_groups.chinese: 来收集数据并优化农场产出。

sense_groups.english: The idea is to strap wearable sensors to the animals
sense_groups.chinese: 想法是将可穿戴传感器绑在动物身上

sense_groups.english: that continuously collect data on activity, diet, and overall health.
sense_groups.chinese: 持续收集有关活动、饮食和整体健康的数据。

sense_groups.english: Not only will farmers be able to intervene quickly and more responsibly
sense_groups.chinese: 农民不仅能够快速且更负责任地干预

sense_groups.english: when the system detects a health problem in one of their livestock,
sense_groups.chinese: 当系统检测到他们的牲畜出现健康问题时，

sense_groups.english: but the system will also open a window into the real-time comfort, emotional state, and behavior of these animals.
sense_groups.chinese: 而且该系统还将打开一扇窗户，了解这些动物的实时舒适度、情绪状态和行为。

sense_groups.english: Although precision livestock farming is, for the moment, a very niche approach,
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管精准畜牧业目前是一种非常小众的方法，
