sense_groups.chinese: 但它正在迅速扩张，并且可以想象成为常态

sense_groups.english: driven by surging labor costs and growing demand for protein and dairy products.
sense_groups.chinese: 受劳动力成本飙升以及对蛋白质和乳制品需求增长的推动。

questions.name: #828 Greenhouse Gas
questions.en:
Climate change is impacting human lives and health in a variety of ways.
It threatens the essential ______ of good health – clean air, safe drinking water, nutritious food supply and safe shelter – and has the potential to ______ decades of progress in global health.
Between 2030 and 2050, climate change is expected to cause approximately 250,000 additional deaths per year from malnutrition, malaria, diarrhoea and heat stress alone.
Areas with weak health infrastructure – mostly in developing countries – will be the least able to ______ without assistance to prepare and respond.
Greenhouse gas emissions that result from the extraction and burning of fossil fuels are major ______ to both climate change and air pollution.
Many policies and individual measures have the potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and produce major health co-benefits, particularly by abating air pollution.
The phase out of polluting energy system could both lower carbon emissions and cut the ______ of household and ambient air pollution.
1. drugs , skills , points , ingredients
2. underlie , underscore , undermine , underpin
3. complete , cope , form , content
4. attractions , depressions , differences , contributors
5. burden , risk , cord , rate
questions.full:
Climate change is impacting human lives and health in a variety of ways.
It threatens the essential ______ of good health – clean air, safe drinking water, nutritious food supply and safe shelter – and has the potential to ______ decades of progress in global health.
Between 2030 and 2050, climate change is expected to cause approximately 250,000 additional deaths per year from malnutrition, malaria, diarrhoea and heat stress alone.
Areas with weak health infrastructure – mostly in developing countries – will be the least able to ______ without assistance to prepare and respond.
Greenhouse gas emissions that result from the extraction and burning of fossil fuels are major ______ to both climate change and air pollution.
Many policies and individual measures have the potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and produce major health co-benefits, particularly by abating air pollution.
The phase out of polluting energy system could both lower carbon emissions and cut the ______ of household and ambient air pollution.

1. drugs , skills , points , ingredients
2. underlie , underscore , undermine , underpin
3. complete , cope , form , content
4. attractions , depressions , differences , contributors
5. burden , risk , cord , rate

答案:
1. ingredients
2. undermine
3. cope
4. contributors
5. burden

sense_groups.english: Climate change is impacting human lives and health in a variety of ways.
sense_groups.chinese: 气候变化正在以多种方式影响人类的生活和健康。

sense_groups.english: It threatens the essential ingredients of good health – clean air, safe drinking water, nutritious food supply and safe shelter –
sense_groups.chinese: 它威胁着良好健康的基本要素——清洁的空气、安全的饮用水、营养丰富的食物供应和安全的住所——

sense_groups.english: and has the potential to undermine decades of progress in global health.
sense_groups.chinese: 并有可能破坏全球健康领域数十年的进步。

sense_groups.english: Between 2030 and 2050, climate change is expected to cause approximately 250,000 additional deaths per year from malnutrition, malaria, diarrhoea and heat stress alone.
sense_groups.chinese: 预计在2030年至2050年间，仅因营养不良、疟疾、腹泻和热应激，气候变化每年将导致约25万人额外死亡。

sense_groups.english: Areas with weak health infrastructure – mostly in developing countries – will be the least able to cope without assistance to prepare and respond.
sense_groups.chinese: 卫生基础设施薄弱的地区——主要是在发展中国家——将最没有能力在没有援助的情况下准备和应对。

sense_groups.english: Greenhouse gas emissions that result from the extraction and burning of fossil fuels are major contributors to both climate change and air pollution.
sense_groups.chinese: 化石燃料的开采和燃烧产生的温室气体是气候变化和空气污染的主要促成因素。

sense_groups.english: Many policies and individual measures have the potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and produce major health co-benefits, particularly by abating air pollution.
sense_groups.chinese: 许多政策和个体措施有潜力减少温室气体排放，并产生重大的健康协同效益，特别是通过减少空气污染。

sense_groups.english: The phase out of polluting energy system could both lower carbon emissions and cut the burden of household and ambient air pollution.
sense_groups.chinese: 逐步淘汰污染性能源系统既可以降低碳排放，也可以减轻家庭和环境空气污染的负担。

questions.name: #829 Video Games
questions.en:
Video gaming is highly ______ in modern culture, particularly among young people, and a healthy hobby for most users.
However, in recent years there has been increasing global recognition among public health professionals and academics that particular patterns of video gaming may lead to marked ______ in personal, family, social, educational, occupational or other important areas of functioning and psychological distress for a significant minority of players.
People who partake in gaming should be ______ to the amount of time they spend on gaming activities, particularly when it is to the exclusion of other daily activities, as well as to any changes in their physical or psychological health and social functioning that could be ______ to their pattern of gaming behavior.
1. visible , selective , targeted , prevalent
2. impairment , traits , increase , improvements
3. alert , necessary , dedicated , related
4. assaulted , instituted , electrocuted , attributed
questions.full:
Video gaming is highly ______ in modern culture, particularly among young people, and a healthy hobby for most users.
However, in recent years there has been increasing global recognition among public health professionals and academics that particular patterns of video gaming may lead to marked ______ in personal, family, social, educational, occupational or other important areas of functioning and psychological distress for a significant minority of players.
People who partake in gaming should be ______ to the amount of time they spend on gaming activities, particularly when it is to the exclusion of other daily activities, as well as to any changes in their physical or psychological health and social functioning that could be ______ to their pattern of gaming behavior.

1. visible , selective , targeted , prevalent
2. impairment , traits , increase , improvements
3. alert , necessary , dedicated , related
4. assaulted , instituted , electrocuted , attributed

答案:
1. prevalent
2. impairment
3. alert
4. attributed

sense_groups.english: Video gaming is highly prevalent in modern culture, particularly among young people, and a healthy hobby for most users.
sense_groups.chinese: 电子游戏在现代文化中非常普遍，尤其在年轻人中，并且对大多数用户来说是一种健康的爱好。

sense_groups.english: However, in recent years there has been increasing global recognition among public health professionals and academics that particular patterns of video gaming may lead to marked impairment in personal, family, social, educational, occupational or other important areas of functioning and psychological distress for a significant minority of players.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，近年来，公共卫生专业人士和学者在全球范围内越来越认识到，特定的电子游戏模式可能会导致少数玩家在个人、家庭、社交、教育、职业或其他重要功能领域出现显著损害，并造成心理困扰。

sense_groups.english: People who partake in gaming should be alert to the amount of time they spend on gaming activities, particularly when it is to the exclusion of other daily activities, as well as to any changes in their physical or psychological health and social functioning that could be attributed to their pattern of gaming behavior.
sense_groups.chinese: 参与游戏的人应该警惕他们在游戏活动上花费的时间，特别是当这排除了其他日常活动时，同时也要注意任何可能归因于其游戏行为模式的身体或心理健康以及社交功能的变化。

questions.name: #830 Alcohol
questions.en:
Alcohol is a toxic and psychoactive substance with dependence-producing properties.
In many of today’s societies, alcoholic beverages are a routine part of the social ______ for many in the population.
This is particularly true for those in social environments with high visibility and societal influence, nationally and internationally, where alcohol frequently ______ socializing.
In this context, it is easy to ______ or discount the health and social damage caused or contributed to by drinking.
Overall, harmful use of alcohol is responsible for 5.1% of the global burden of disease.
Harmful use of alcohol is ______ for 7.1% and 2.2% of the global burden of disease for males and females respectively.
Alcohol is the leading risk factor for premature mortality and disability among those aged 15 to 49 years, accounting for 10% of all deaths in this age group.
1. landscape , program , protection , development
2. accompanies , assesses , invites , founds
3. overlay , overbuy , overlap , overlook
4. ideal , substitute , important , accountable
questions.full:
Alcohol is a toxic and psychoactive substance with dependence-producing properties.
In many of today’s societies, alcoholic beverages are a routine part of the social ______ for many in the population.
This is particularly true for those in social environments with high visibility and societal influence, nationally and internationally, where alcohol frequently ______ socializing.
In this context, it is easy to ______ or discount the health and social damage caused or contributed to by drinking.
Overall, harmful use of alcohol is responsible for 5.1% of the global burden of disease.
Harmful use of alcohol is ______ for 7.1% and 2.2% of the global burden of disease for males and females respectively.
Alcohol is the leading risk factor for premature mortality and disability among those aged 15 to 49 years, accounting for 10% of all deaths in this age group.

1. landscape , program , protection , development
2. accompanies , assesses , invites , founds
3. overlay , overbuy , overlap , overlook
4. ideal , substitute , important , accountable

答案:
1. landscape
2. accompanies
3. overlook
4. accountable

sense_groups.english: Alcohol is a toxic and psychoactive substance with dependence-producing properties.
sense_groups.chinese: 酒精是一种有毒且具有精神活性的物质，具有成瘾性。

sense_groups.english: In many of today’s societies, alcoholic beverages are a routine part of the social landscape for many in the population.
sense_groups.chinese: 在当今许多社会中，酒精饮料是许多人社交生活中的常规组成部分。

sense_groups.english: This is particularly true for those in social environments with high visibility and societal influence, nationally and internationally, where alcohol frequently accompanies socializing.
sense_groups.chinese: 对于那些在国内和国际上具有高知名度和影响力的社交环境中的人来说尤其如此，在这些环境中，酒精常常伴随着社交活动。

sense_groups.english: In this context, it is easy to overlook or discount the health and social damage caused or contributed to by drinking.
sense_groups.chinese: 在这种背景下，人们很容易忽视或低估饮酒造成或加剧的健康和社会损害。

sense_groups.english: Overall, harmful use of alcohol is responsible for 5.1% of the global burden of disease.
sense_groups.chinese: 总体而言，有害使用酒精占全球疾病负担的5.1%。

sense_groups.english: Harmful use of alcohol is accountable for 7.1% and 2.2% of the global burden of disease for males and females respectively.
sense_groups.chinese: 有害使用酒精分别占男性和女性全球疾病负担的7.1%和2.2%。

sense_groups.english: Alcohol is the leading risk factor for premature mortality and disability among those aged 15 to 49 years, accounting for 10% of all deaths in this age group.
sense_groups.chinese: 酒精是15至49岁人群过早死亡和残疾的主要风险因素，占该年龄组所有死亡人数的10%。

questions.name: #831 Feedback
questions.en:
Because feedback is a message sent in the ______ direction, from the receiver to the sender, all of these problems can occur during feedback.
In many cases feedback is not important and is not wanted.
Much information that is communicated is intended to keep people ______ , and acknowledgement or response is not expected.
When management sent the notice about Mathias’s appointment it did not expect every employee to respond.
Sometimes, though, feedback is important to be certain that both the sender and receiver have the same information and ______ it the same way.
The initial sender must be sure that she understands the feedback provided by the sender, asks questions to ______ any misinterpretation, and responds to any questions.
The last step in good communication is to be a good listener.
1. opposite , requisite , desperate , composite
2. informed , unnerved , inspired , nerved
3. interconnect , interchange , interpret , recycle
4. intensify , clarify , classify , diversify
questions.full:
Because feedback is a message sent in the ______ direction, from the receiver to the sender, all of these problems can occur during feedback.
In many cases feedback is not important and is not wanted.
Much information that is communicated is intended to keep people ______ , and acknowledgement or response is not expected.
When management sent the notice about Mathias’s appointment it did not expect every employee to respond.
Sometimes, though, feedback is important to be certain that both the sender and receiver have the same information and ______ it the same way.
The initial sender must be sure that she understands the feedback provided by the sender, asks questions to ______ any misinterpretation, and responds to any questions.
The last step in good communication is to be a good listener.

1. opposite , requisite , desperate , composite
2. informed , unnerved , inspired , nerved
3. interconnect , interchange , interpret , recycle
4. intensify , clarify , classify , diversify

答案:
1. opposite
2. informed
3. interpret
4. clarify

sense_groups.english: Because feedback is a message sent in the opposite direction, from the receiver to the sender,
sense_groups.chinese: 因为反馈是朝相反方向发送的信息，从接收者到发送者，

sense_groups.english: all of these problems can occur during feedback.
sense_groups.chinese: 所有这些在反馈过程中都可能发生。

sense_groups.english: In many cases feedback is not important and is not wanted.
sense_groups.chinese: 在许多情况下，反馈并不重要，也不被需要。

sense_groups.english: Much information that is communicated is intended to keep people informed,
sense_groups.chinese: 许多被传达的信息旨在让人们了解情况，

sense_groups.english: and acknowledgement or response is not expected.
sense_groups.chinese: 并且不期望得到确认或回应。

sense_groups.english: When management sent the notice about Mathias’s appointment it did not expect every employee to respond.
sense_groups.chinese: 当管理层发出关于马蒂亚斯任命的通知时，并不期望每个员工都回复。

sense_groups.english: Sometimes, though, feedback is important to be certain that both the sender and receiver have the same information and interpret it the same way.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，有时反馈很重要，以确保发送者和接收者拥有相同的信息并以相同的方式理解它。

sense_groups.english: The initial sender must be sure that she understands the feedback provided by the sender,
sense_groups.chinese: 最初的发送者必须确保她理解发送者提供的反馈，

sense_groups.english: asks questions to clarify any misinterpretation,
sense_groups.chinese: 提出问题以澄清任何误解，

questions.name: #833 Information Overload
questions.en:
We have all been in situations when we felt that too much information was coming at us.
When this happens, we feel ______ and fear that we will not be able to retain any information at all.
Sometimes it is not just the quantity of communication but the level that causes overload.
If the message contains information that is new to the receiver, ______ processes or concepts that are not familiar, then the chances of overload increase greatly.
The sender should break up the message into more ______ or digestible bits and reduce the amount of information that has to be absorbed at any one time.
One technique is to make a high-level announcement and then follow it up later with more details.
The sender has the ______ responsibility to check that the receiver has understood the message.
This means that a manager may have to ______ a message to reflect the various experiences of the employees.
A new employee may need repeated explanations before beginning an operation, whereas an experienced employee may start rolling his eyes at the same old instructions.

3. discreditable , unaccountable , palatable , unprofitable

questions.full:

sense_groups.english: We have all been in situations when we felt that too much information was coming at us.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们都曾遇到过信息铺天盖地而来的情况。

sense_groups.chinese: 这时，我们会感到不知所措，担心自己根本记不住任何信息。

sense_groups.english: Sometimes it is not just the quantity of communication but the level that causes overload.
sense_groups.chinese: 有时，导致信息超载的不仅是沟通的数量，还有沟通的层次。

sense_groups.chinese: 发送者应将信息分解成更易接受或消化的片段，减少每次需要吸收的信息量。

sense_groups.chinese: 一种技巧是先做高层级的宣布，之后再补充更多细节。

sense_groups.english: The sender has the primary responsibility to check that the receiver has understood the message.
sense_groups.chinese: 发送者负有首要责任，确认接收者已理解信息。

questions.name: #844 Eco-anxiety
questions.en:
Eco-anxiety is already causing people to lose sleep over climate change.
Now, a global study has found that a warming planet is also affecting how long people sleep, and the problem will get significantly worse this century even if humanity manages to ______ in its carbon emissions.
Our measurements of the impact of above-average night temperatures on sleep have previously been limited by being ______ to single countries, lab studies or notoriously unreliable self-reporting of sleep.
To glean a better real-world picture, Kelton Minor at the University of Copenhagen, Denmark, took data from sleep-tracking wristbands used by 48,000 people in 68 countries between 2015 and 2017.
He and his colleagues then ______ the sleep data with local weather data, revealing that unusually hot nights are causing people to fall asleep later, rise earlier and sleep less.
1. join , rein , gain , vein
2. decided , expected , required , confined
3. contained , controlled , paired , accessed

questions.name: #845 Meat and Dairy

questions.name: #846 Subjective Age
questions.en:
“Age is an issue of mind over matter.
If you don’t mind, it doesn’t matter.” This nugget of wisdom, often attributed to Mark Twain, has been turned into many an inspirational internet meme over the years.
As a 51-year-old who is starting to feel the gathering momentum of the inevitable slide, it strikes me as little more than a platitude that makes people feel better about getting old.

Subjective age – how old we feel – has a very real impact on health and ______ .
People who feel younger than their years often actually are, in terms of how long they have left to live.
The question of what controls our subjective age, and whether we can change it, has always been tricky to ______ scientifically.

2. inspirational , invalid , unconventional , instrumental
3. subjectivity , sensitivity , longevity , objectivity
4. test , produce , address , measure

questions.name: #848 Chronic Pain
questions.en:
When pain lasts for three months or longer, it is classified as chronic, a condition that affects more than 30 per cent of the world’s population.
Chronic pain was long believed to be a stubborn version of ______ pain – which passes in less than three months once the damage is healed – and it was treated in much the same way.
Yet an increasing body of research has led doctors to believe that chronic pain should be treated as a disease in its own right, rather than an ______ symptom of tissue damage or physical trauma.
This could have major ______ for the treatment of lasting pain, together with the way we prescribe addictive opioids.
Recent research has revealed that in some people, chronic pain is a problem with the brain.
An injury can lead to pain that ______ after the tissue has recovered because the brain has rewired itself and learned to send pain signals, despite there no longer being a reason.
Known as central sensitization, it is as if the volume has been turned up on pain.
1. accurate , acumen , acute , prosecute
2. endurance , endurable , endured , enduring
3. improvisations , importations , implications , supplications
4. demands , persists , perceives , tastes

sense_groups.english: As opposed to a traditional linear economy in which we make, consume, and throw away, moving circular is all about creating a circle where we design out waste and pollution by keeping products and materials in use for as long as possible and finding ways to create new resources from what we discard .

sense_groups.english: With the circular economy, we’re extracting the maximum value from products while in use, then recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of each service life.
sense_groups.chinese: 通过循环经济，我们在产品使用期间提取最大价值，然后在每个使用寿命结束时回收和再生产品和材料。

sense_groups.english: The circular economy puts a big focus on services, maintenance, and refurbishment of assets.
sense_groups.chinese: 循环经济非常注重资产的服务、维护和翻新。

sense_groups.english: However, as resources become more and more scarce, manufacturers and distributors in the circular economy are introducing additional value-added services.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，随着资源越来越稀缺，循环经济中的制造商和分销商正在引入额外的增值服务。

questions.name: #850 IMF
questions.en:
The International Monetary Fund (IMF), headquartered in Washington, DC, is ______ of 189 member countries.
The IMF works to foster global growth and economic stability by providing policy, advice, and financing to its members.
It also works with developing nations to help them reduce poverty and achieve macroeconomic ______ .
It now plays a central role in the management of balance-of-payments difficulties and international financial crises.
When the IMF was founded, its primary functions were to provide short-term capital to ______ the balance of payments and to oversee fixed-exchange-rate arrangements between countries, thus helping national governments manage their exchange rates and prioritize economic growth.
This ______ was meant to prevent the spread of international economic crises.
The IMF mission changed slightly after 1971, and floating currency exchange rates made it harder to predict the economic stability of a region.
Today the IMF plays an active role in ______ and managing economic policy around the world.
1. presented , divided , apprised , comprised
2. stability , utility , docility , nasality
3. mobilize , prohibit , inhabit , aid
4. substance , circumstance , instance , assistance
5. manifesting , fading , shaping , resolving

The IMF works to foster global growth and economic stability by providing policy, advice, and financing to its members.

sense_groups.english: The International Monetary Fund (IMF), headquartered in Washington, DC, is comprised of 189 member countries.
sense_groups.chinese: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）总部位于华盛顿特区，由189个成员国组成。

sense_groups.english: The IMF works to foster global growth and economic stability by providing policy, advice, and financing to its members.
sense_groups.chinese: IMF通过向其成员提供政策、建议和融资，致力于促进全球增长和经济稳定。

sense_groups.english: It also works with developing nations to help them reduce poverty and achieve macroeconomic stability.
sense_groups.chinese: 它还与发展中国家合作，帮助它们减少贫困并实现宏观经济稳定。

sense_groups.english: It now plays a central role in the management of balance-of-payments difficulties and international financial crises.
sense_groups.chinese: 它现在在管理国际收支困难和国际金融危机方面发挥着核心作用。

sense_groups.english: When the IMF was founded, its primary functions were to provide short-term capital to aid the balance of payments and to oversee fixed-exchange-rate arrangements between countries, thus helping national governments manage their exchange rates and prioritize economic growth.
sense_groups.chinese: IMF成立时，其主要职能是提供短期资本以帮助国际收支，并监督国家间的固定汇率安排，从而帮助各国政府管理汇率并优先考虑经济增长。

sense_groups.english: This assistance was meant to prevent the spread of international economic crises.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种援助旨在防止国际经济危机的蔓延。

sense_groups.english: The IMF mission changed slightly after 1971, and floating currency exchange rates made it harder to predict the economic stability of a region.
sense_groups.chinese: 1971年后，IMF的使命略有变化，浮动汇率使得预测一个地区的经济稳定性变得更加困难。

sense_groups.english: Today the IMF plays an active role in shaping and managing economic policy around the world.
sense_groups.chinese: 如今，IMF在塑造和管理全球经济政策方面发挥着积极作用。

questions.name: #851 Sliced Apples
questions.en:
You open your lunch box to discover that the lovely apple you sliced this morning now appears unsightly and brown.
Why does this happen?
This ______ phenomenon is actually due to a chain of biochemical reactions known as “enzymatic browning.” When an apple is injured (or cut into pieces), the plant tissue is exposed to oxygen.
This ______ an enzyme known as polyphenol oxidase (PPO) to oxidize polyphenols in the apple’s flesh.
This results in new chemicals (o-quinones), which then react with amino acids to produce brown-colored melanins.
Different apple varieties contain different amounts of both the initial enzyme and the polyphenols, and thus they brown at different rates.
Enzymatic browning is not ______ to apples; pears, bananas, and eggplants also turn brown fairly quickly when cut.
Enzymatic browning is also responsible for the desirable dark color of prunes, coffee, black tea, and cocoa.
Scientists are working to genetically ______ apples that do not produce the PPO enzyme, so perhaps brown apples will someday be a thing of the past.
1. unappetizing , galvanizing , anthologizing , characterizing
2. triggers , simplifies , fosters , constricts
3. contended , related , profiled , unique
4. designate , envelope , dilute , engineer
questions.full:
You open your lunch box to discover that the lovely apple you sliced this morning now appears unsightly and brown.
Why does this happen?
This ______ phenomenon is actually due to a chain of biochemical reactions known as “enzymatic browning.” When an apple is injured (or cut into pieces), the plant tissue is exposed to oxygen.
This ______ an enzyme known as polyphenol oxidase (PPO) to oxidize polyphenols in the apple’s flesh.

2. triggers , simplifies , fosters , constricts
3. contended , related , profiled , unique
4. designate , envelope , dilute , engineer

答案:
1. unappetizing
2. triggers
3. unique
4. engineer

sense_groups.english: You open your lunch box to discover that the lovely apple you sliced this morning now appears unsightly and brown.
sense_groups.chinese: 你打开午餐盒，发现早上切好的可爱苹果现在看起来难看且变褐了。

sense_groups.english: Why does this happen?
sense_groups.chinese: 为什么会这样？

sense_groups.english: This unappetizing phenomenon is actually due to a chain of biochemical reactions known as “enzymatic browning.”
sense_groups.chinese: 这种令人倒胃口的现象实际上是由一系列称为“酶促褐变”的生化反应引起的。

sense_groups.english: When an apple is injured (or cut into pieces), the plant tissue is exposed to oxygen.
sense_groups.chinese: 当苹果受伤（或被切成块）时，植物组织暴露在氧气中。

sense_groups.english: This triggers an enzyme known as polyphenol oxidase (PPO) to oxidize polyphenols in the apple’s flesh.
sense_groups.chinese: 这会触发一种称为多酚氧化酶（PPO）的酶氧化苹果果肉中的多酚。

sense_groups.english: This results in new chemicals (o-quinones), which then react with amino acids to produce brown-colored melanins.
sense_groups.chinese: 这会产生新的化学物质（邻醌），然后与氨基酸反应生成褐色的黑色素。

sense_groups.english: Different apple varieties contain different amounts of both the initial enzyme and the polyphenols, and thus they brown at different rates.
sense_groups.chinese: 不同品种的苹果含有不同量的初始酶和多酚，因此它们褐变的速度不同。

sense_groups.english: Enzymatic browning is not unique to apples; pears, bananas, and eggplants also turn brown fairly quickly when cut.
sense_groups.chinese: 酶促褐变并非苹果独有；梨、香蕉和茄子切开后也会很快变褐。

sense_groups.english: Enzymatic browning is also responsible for the desirable dark color of prunes, coffee, black tea, and cocoa.
sense_groups.chinese: 酶促褐变也导致了梅干、咖啡、红茶和可可理想的深色。

sense_groups.english: Scientists are working to genetically engineer apples that do not produce the PPO enzyme, so perhaps brown apples will someday be a thing of the past.
sense_groups.chinese: 科学家们正在努力通过基因工程培育不产生PPO酶的苹果，所以也许褐变苹果有一天会成为历史。

questions.name: #852 Christopher Columbus
questions.en:
In 1492, Italian sailor Christopher Columbus, sent by Spain, arrived in the New World.
This was a dramatic event for both the people who already lived in the Americas and for Europe.
Native Americans fell ______ to an immense plague of European diseases which weakened them in the face of armies led by Spanish conquistadors.
Within a few decades, Spain conquered the Caribbean, the Aztec Empire of modern-day Mexico, and the Inca Empire stretching across the Andes.
Native Americans were ______ and forced to work on plantations and mines.
As a result, Spain grew rich and powerful.
The other countries of Europe looked upon the success of Spain with envy.

2. enclosed , engaged , enslaved , encountered
3. prosperous , porous , phosphorus , courteous

questions.name: #853 Solanine
questions.en:
When potatoes are stored in a warm bright place, the tubers detect that they might be in a suitable growing location and prepare to sprout.
Chlorophyll production increases, which slowly tints the peel, and eventually some of the flesh, green.
While chlorophyll is a harmless chemical, its ______ in potatoes indicates that the tubers have also increased their production of a glycoalkaloid known as solanine.

Cooking does not destroy the solanine toxin, so the green parts of potatoes should be ______ entirely.
Green potatoes should especially not be served to children, whose smaller bodies make them more susceptible to poisoning.

2. preserve , deserve , conserve , reserve
3. ingestion , congestion , suggestion , predilection
4. regrouped , retired , removed , reformed

questions.name: #854 Cactus
questions.en:
You may have heard that you can get water from a cactus if you are ever lost and ______ in a desert.
Does it sound like a nice survival tip to store away, but is it really that easy?
It turns out that a cactus is not actually a spine-covered basin of fresh water.
Such a plant would not last long in an ______ habitat filled with thirsty animals.
Water is truly a precious resource in a desert, so, in addition to their ______ spines, most cactus species further protect their spongy flesh with acids and potent alkaloids.
These chemicals are usually too acrid for most humans to tolerate and are ______ on the kidneys if ingested.
The flesh of some cactus species can also cause vomiting, diarrhea, or temporary paralysis — none of which is ______ to your survival in an emergency situation.
Cactus fruits are a better bet, though many are also unpalatable if eaten raw.

2. acrid , arid , hybrid , avid
3. liquidating , invalidating , intimidating , elucidating
4. detoxing , fixing , taxing , affixing
5. coercive , conducive , enhancive , seductive

sense_groups.english: You may have heard that you can get water from a cactus if you are ever lost and dehydrated in a desert.
sense_groups.chinese: 你可能听说过，如果你在沙漠中迷路并脱水，可以从仙人掌中获取水分。

sense_groups.english: Does it sound like a nice survival tip to store away, but is it really that easy?
sense_groups.chinese: 这听起来像是一个值得记住的生存技巧，但真的那么容易吗？

sense_groups.english: It turns out that a cactus is not actually a spine-covered basin of fresh water.
sense_groups.chinese: 事实证明，仙人掌实际上并不是一个覆盖着刺的淡水容器。

sense_groups.english: Such a plant would not last long in an arid habitat filled with thirsty animals.
sense_groups.chinese: 这样的植物在充满口渴动物的干旱栖息地中无法长久生存。

sense_groups.english: Water is truly a precious resource in a desert, so, in addition to their intimidating spines, most cactus species further protect their spongy flesh with acids and potent alkaloids.
sense_groups.chinese: 水在沙漠中确实是宝贵的资源，因此，除了它们令人生畏的刺之外，大多数仙人掌物种还通过酸和强效生物碱来保护它们海绵状的果肉。

sense_groups.english: These chemicals are usually too acrid for most humans to tolerate and are taxing on the kidneys if ingested.
sense_groups.chinese: 这些化学物质通常过于辛辣，大多数人类无法忍受，如果摄入会对肾脏造成负担。

sense_groups.english: The flesh of some cactus species can also cause vomiting, diarrhea, or temporary paralysis — none of which is conducive to your survival in an emergency situation.
sense_groups.chinese: 某些仙人掌物种的果肉还可能引起呕吐、腹泻或暂时性瘫痪——这些都不利于你在紧急情况下的生存。

sense_groups.english: Cactus fruits are a better bet, though many are also unpalatable if eaten raw.
sense_groups.chinese: 仙人掌果实是更好的选择，尽管许多生吃时也不可口。

4. homestay , mainstay , stay , overstay

sense_groups.chinese: 一种令人愉悦的风味组合，让人联想到欧芹和柑橘，

sense_groups.english: the herb is a common ingredient in many cuisines around the world.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种香草是世界各地许多菜肴中的常见成分。

sense_groups.english: However, some people find cilantro revolting.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，有些人觉得香菜令人反感。

sense_groups.english: Of course some of this dislike may come down to simple preference,
sense_groups.chinese: 当然，这种不喜欢可能只是出于简单的偏好，

sense_groups.english: but for those cilantro-haters for whom the plant tastes like soap,
sense_groups.chinese: 但对于那些觉得香菜尝起来像肥皂的厌恶者来说，

sense_groups.english: the issue is genetic.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个问题是遗传的。

sense_groups.english: These people have a variation in a group of olfactory-receptor genes
sense_groups.chinese: 这些人在一组嗅觉受体基因上有一个变异，

sense_groups.english: that allows them to strongly perceive the soapy-flavored aldehydes in cilantro leaves.
sense_groups.chinese: 这使他们能够强烈感知到香菜叶子中肥皂味的醛类物质。

sense_groups.english: This genetic quirk is usually only found in a small percent of the population,
sense_groups.chinese: 这种遗传特性通常只在一小部分人中发现，

sense_groups.english: though it varies geographically.
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管它因地域而异。

sense_groups.english: Interestingly, places where cilantro is especially popular have fewer people with these genes,
sense_groups.chinese: 有趣的是，香菜特别受欢迎的地方拥有这些基因的人更少，

sense_groups.english: which might explain how the herb was able to become such a mainstay in those regions.
sense_groups.chinese: 这或许可以解释为什么这种香草能在那些地区成为如此重要的食材。

sense_groups.english: East Asians have the highest incidence of this variation.
sense_groups.chinese: 东亚人拥有这种变异的比例最高。

sense_groups.english: There is some evidence that cilantrophobes can overcome their aversion
sense_groups.chinese: 有证据表明，厌恶香菜的人可以克服他们的反感，

sense_groups.english: with repeated exposure to the herb,
sense_groups.chinese: 通过反复接触这种香草，

sense_groups.english: especially if it is crushed rather than served whole.
sense_groups.chinese: 尤其是当它被切碎而不是整片食用时。

questions.name: #856 Memory Illusion
questions.en:
When considering what makes us who we are, it is easy to think our memories are the answer.
Aside from the physical traces of the passing of time on your body, your ______ are perhaps the only thing that links the you sitting here today to the many yous from every previous day of your existence.
Without them, your relationships would mean nothing, not to ______ your knowledge, tastes, and your many adventures.
It might be no ______ to say your memories are the essence of you.
With this in mind, it is not surprising that much of the burgeoning field of neuroscience has turned its efforts to understanding what makes a memory and how to keep hold of it.
Perhaps the most ______ idea to come from recent discoveries is a re-imagining of the dark side of memory – forgetting.
1. collections , maledictions , recollections , conjunctions
2. carry , mention , remain , take
3. transfiguration , exaggeration , generation , consideration
4. saluting , intriguing , indicting , corrupting

sense_groups.chinese: 当思考是什么造就了我们时，很容易认为记忆就是答案。

sense_groups.english: Aside from the physical traces of the passing of time on your body, your recollections are perhaps the only thing that links the you sitting here today to the many yous from every previous day of your existence.
sense_groups.chinese: 除了时间在你身体上留下的物理痕迹，你的回忆或许是唯一将今天坐在这里的你与过去每一天的无数个你联系起来的纽带。

sense_groups.english: Without them, your relationships would mean nothing, not to mention your knowledge, tastes, and your many adventures.
sense_groups.chinese: 没有它们，你的人际关系将毫无意义，更不用说你的知识、品味和众多冒险经历。

sense_groups.english: It might be no exaggeration to say your memories are the essence of you.
sense_groups.chinese: 可以毫不夸张地说，你的记忆就是你的本质。

sense_groups.english: With this in mind, it is not surprising that much of the burgeoning field of neuroscience has turned its efforts to understanding what makes a memory and how to keep hold of it.
sense_groups.chinese: 考虑到这一点，新兴的神经科学领域大部分努力都转向理解记忆的形成以及如何保持记忆，也就不足为奇了。

sense_groups.english: Perhaps the most intriguing idea to come from recent discoveries is a re-imagining of the dark side of memory – forgetting.
sense_groups.chinese: 也许最近发现中最有趣的想法是对记忆的阴暗面——遗忘——的重新构想。

questions.name: #857 Earth's Land
questions.en:
Earth’s continental crust may have emerged 500 million years earlier than scientists had previously estimated.
Pinning down when our planet’s land emerged could help us understand the conditions in which ______ life began.
Today, new oceanic crust rises at mid-ocean ridges where tectonic plates drift apart.
Continental crust is usually much older, formed from volcanism where plates crash into each other, ______ a thicker, less-dense layer above sea level.
Weathering of continental crust adds ______ to the ocean, a process that may have played a role in supporting primordial life.
The big question is: when did continental crusts start forming?
To try to answer that, Desiree Roerdink at the University of Bergen in Norway and her colleagues analyzed 30 ancient rock samples from six sites in Australia, South Africa and India.
These contained barite, which can form in hydrothermal vents – fissures in the ocean floor ______ warm, mineral-rich waters react with seawater.
1. spatial , primitive , vegetation , primate
2. everlasting , infesting , harvesting , thrusting
3. evidence , waste , nutrients , orients
4. which , where , why , what

questions.name: #858 Egg Whites
questions.en:

In fact, since plastic is not decomposable, environmental scientists have been scrambling to come up with ways to ______ the planet of microplastics and keep our waterways clean.
And they have successfully used egg whites to create a lightweight and porous aerogel material that can be used in several ways, including water filtration, energy storage, and sound, as well as insulation.
The structure has the ability to remove both salt and microplastics from seawater in remarkable ways, doing so with 98% and 99% efficiency, ______ .
And the experiments were done with regular store-bought eggs, which means that future work can be done in a cost-effective way.
The only issue with this is that there would be such a large demand for eggs that it could possibly outcompete the food industry.
Once this is tackled, using these structures will work ______ as an effective, energy-efficient, and cost-effective method.
1. freaking , wreaking , breaking , creaking
2. study , rid , dominate , surround
3. respectively , distributively , interrogatively , retrospectively
4. monthly , unearthly , smoothly , earthly

questions.name: #860 Population Decline
questions.en:
There are soon to be 8 billion of us and counting.
Yet while the world’s population is still growing fast overall, in many countries, the numbers are ______ or will do soon.
The population of China will begin to fall soon and could halve by 2100.
India’s will peak around 2050.
And the US population would fall from the 2030s if not for immigration.
So there are two ______ issues to deal with: rapid population growth in some nations and population declines in others.
Many see limiting population growth as vital for tackling various environmental catastrophes ______ around the world, as we report on in our article “What will a population of 8 billion people mean for us and the planet?” Yet for wealthy Westerners to call for lower-income countries to control their populations simply in the name of protecting nature is hypocritical in the extreme, given that the rich have vastly larger environmental footprints.
What’s more, there is often more than a ______ of racism to such calls.
1. combining , delectable , declining , reclining
2. selective , distinct , corresponding , extinct
3. shrinking , bustling , harnessing , unfolding
4. variety , range , whiff , number

sense_groups.chinese: 然而，尽管全球人口总体上仍在快速增长，但在许多国家，人口数量正在下降或即将下降。

sense_groups.english: The population of China will begin to fall soon and could halve by 2100.

sense_groups.english: India’s will peak around 2050.
sense_groups.chinese: 印度人口将在2050年左右达到峰值。

sense_groups.english: And the US population would fall from the 2030s if not for immigration.
sense_groups.chinese: 而如果没有移民，美国人口将从2030年代开始下降。

sense_groups.english: So there are two distinct issues to deal with: rapid population growth in some nations and population declines in others.

questions.name: #861 Teenage Daughter
questions.en:
Your teenage daughter gets top marks in school, captains the debate team, and volunteers at a shelter for homeless people.
But while driving the family car, she text-messages her best friend and rear-ends another vehicle.
How can teens be so clever, accomplished, and responsible-and reckless ______ ______ ______ ______ ?
Easily, according to two physicians at Children's Hospital Boston and Harvard Medical School (HMS) who have been ______ the unique structure and chemistry of the adolescent brain ."The teenage brain is not just an ______ brain with fewer miles on it," says Frances E. Jensen, a professor of neurology.
"It's a paradoxical time of ______ .
These are people with very sharp brains, but they're not quite sure what to do with them."
Research during the past 10 years, powered by technology such as functional magnetic resonance imaging, has revealed that young brains have ______ fast-growing synapses and sections that remain unconnected.
This leaves teens easily influenced by their environment and more prone to impulsive behavior, even without the ______ of souped-up hormones and any genetic or family predispositions.
1. for the time being , at the same time , as ever , in good time
2. exposing , exploring , enumerating , explaining
3. ample , adult , adulthood , abundant
4. enrichment , development , adulthood , adoration
5. both , few , whole , either
6. impact , impress , impair , impose
questions.answer:
1. at
2. the
3. same
4. time
5. exploring
6. adult
7. development
8. both
9. impact

questions.answer:

sense_groups.english: During the 17th and 18th century, Shakespeare was both admired and condemned.

sense_groups.english: What killed off the dinosaurs?

sense_groups.chinese: 白垩纪末期见证了地球历史上最剧烈的物种大灭绝之一。

sense_groups.english: The Plains Indians were people who did not like to live in one place.

questions.name: #887 Pinker
questions.en:

questions.name: #938 Great Barrier Reef
questions.en:
Amidst the vibrant coral reefs of the Great Barrier Reef, Dr. Maya Sharma isn't just admiring the underwater wonderland.

Around the globe, dedicated scientists like Sharma are diving into the ocean's depths, not for buried treasure or hidden shipwrecks, but for coral fragments.

The race ______ time is on, as coral reefs disappear at an alarming rate.

4. against , through , into , over

sense_groups.english: Amidst the vibrant coral reefs of the Great Barrier Reef, Dr. Maya Sharma isn't just admiring the underwater wonderland.

sense_groups.english: Unlike the thrill of archaeological discovery or the adrenaline rush of exploring uncharted waters, coral collection is a meticulous and critical endeavor.
sense_groups.chinese: 与考古发现的刺激或探索未知水域的肾上腺素飙升不同，珊瑚采集是一项细致且关键的努力。

sense_groups.english: While some pursue these fragments for profit, supplying the booming aquarium industry, others, like Sharma, are driven by a more noble purpose: preservation.

sense_groups.english: Their mission is to rescue and cultivate these vital ecosystems before they vanish into a wave of extinction.

sense_groups.english: They are the guardians of the sea, ensuring that future generations can witness the breathtaking beauty and vital importance of these marine ecosystems.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们是海洋的守护者，确保后代能够见证这些海洋生态系统的惊人美丽和至关重要性。

questions.name: #939 Maya Patel
questions.en:
Dr. Maya Patel stumbled upon a curious statistic while researching water scarcity: a disproportionate number of the world's poorest nations shared one defining ______ - aridity.
This sparked a burning question within her: could the limited availability of water be a missing ______ in the complex puzzle of global economic disparity?
Delving into the research, Dr. Patel and Dr. David Singh began to unravel this intricate relationship.
Their study revealed a striking correlation: countries receiving less than 500 millimeters of annual rainfall consistently struggled with poverty, while those ______ this threshold displayed greater economic prosperity.
The team identified two key mechanisms ______ ______ aridity hampered economic growth.
Firstly, limited water availability severely constrained agricultural productivity, hindering the development of a robust food system and jeopardizing food security.
Secondly, aridity amplified the impact of disease, as stagnant water bodies became breeding ______ for pathogens, leading to higher rates of illness and decreased workforce participation.
This vicious cycle of limited resources and poor health created a significant barrier to economic development.
1. economy , rhythm , characteristic , sequence
2. piece , impact , import , window
3. persisting , switching , exceeding , scoring
4. by them , in that , of those , through which
5. targets , grounds , equations , seas
questions.answer:
1. characteristic
2. piece
3. exceeding
4. through
5. which
6. grounds

sense_groups.english: The 20th century saw two groundbreaking figures in animal research: Konrad Lorenz and Jane Goodall.

questions.name: #972 Coffee Consumption
questions.en:

questions.name: #974 Italy

questions.name: #977 Hierarchy of Needs
questions.en:
Abraham Maslow’s hierarchy of needs is a seminal theory in psychology which describes a five-tier model of human needs.
At the base are physiological needs like food, water, and sleep.
These most basic needs must be ______ first before advancing upwards through the hierarchy.
The next tier contains safety and security needs, including health, employment, property, and social stability.
Higher up is the need for love and belonging, ______ friendships, family, and intimate relationships.
Near the top lies the need for esteem, which involves prestige, confidence, achievement, and respect from others.
At the apex is self-actualization, defined by Maslow as achieving one’s ______ potential, including creative activities and peak experiences.
While intuitive, Maslow’s hierarchy remains controversial among psychologists.
Contemporary research continues ______ and testing the hierarchical ordering and boundaries between need levels.
Nonetheless, the theory endures as an influential framework for understanding human motivation and development.
Specific ______ include designing workplace environments, understanding consumer behavior, and developing self-improvement strategies.
1. talked , collaborated , met , insulated
2. encompassing , differentiating , relating , spiraling
3. overflowing , motivated , native , full
4. to examine , examining , with examination , in examining
5. purposes , applications , blueprints , communities

sense_groups.english: Abraham Maslow’s hierarchy of needs is a seminal theory in psychology
sense_groups.chinese: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛的需求层次理论是心理学中一个开创性的理论

sense_groups.english: which describes a five-tier model of human needs.
sense_groups.chinese: 它描述了人类需求的五层模型。

sense_groups.english: At the base are physiological needs like food, water, and sleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 最底层是生理需求，如食物、水和睡眠。

sense_groups.english: At the apex is self-actualization, defined by Maslow as achieving one’s full potential, including creative activities and peak experiences.

sense_groups.chinese: 尽管直观，马斯洛的层次理论在心理学家中仍存在争议。

sense_groups.english: Contemporary research continues examining and testing the hierarchical ordering and boundaries between need levels.

sense_groups.english: Nonetheless, the theory endures as an influential framework for understanding human motivation and development.

questions.name: #985 Existential Humility
questions.en:

How can we ______ this tendency and challenge our views?

Awe can expand our ______ and make us more open to new ideas and experiences.
By embracing existential humility and cultivating awe, we can become more aware of our ______ and more willing to revise our opinions.
We can also become more respectful of others and more interested in learning from them.

2. question , questioning , in questioning , we question

4. revenues , zones , biases , charges
5. common , individual , public , important

questions.name: #996 Heat Pumps

The human capacity to perceive rapid alterations in visual scenes, colloquially referred to as “speed of sight”, exhibits a remarkable degree of variation among individuals, as revealed by the inaugural systematic ______ into this phenomenon.
This variability in visual acuity may elucidate the differential aptitude observed in individuals when engaging in sports that require ______ of fast-moving objects, such as baseball and cricket.
The study posits that certain individuals ______ an innate superior vision that enables them to follow fast-moving objects with greater precision than others.
This ______ visual prowess could potentially account for the disparities observed in individuals’ performance in ball sports.
The research, led by Clinton Haarlem at Trinity College Dublin, underscores the critical role of visual perception in our interaction with ______ changing environments and its potential implications in the realm of sports.
1. balance , intermission , identification , investigation
2. tracking , distorting , ensuring , transmitting
3. render , store , wear , possess
4. responsible , inherent , verbal , logical
5. typically , vividly , rapidly , basically
questions.full:
The human capacity to perceive rapid alterations in visual scenes, colloquially referred to as “speed of sight”, exhibits a remarkable degree of variation among individuals, as revealed by the inaugural systematic ______ into this phenomenon.
This variability in visual acuity may elucidate the differential aptitude observed in individuals when engaging in sports that require ______ of fast-moving objects, such as baseball and cricket.
The study posits that certain individuals ______ an innate superior vision that enables them to follow fast-moving objects with greater precision than others.
This ______ visual prowess could potentially account for the disparities observed in individuals’ performance in ball sports.
The research, led by Clinton Haarlem at Trinity College Dublin, underscores the critical role of visual perception in our interaction with ______ changing environments and its potential implications in the realm of sports.

1. balance , intermission , identification , investigation
2. tracking , distorting , ensuring , transmitting
3. render , store , wear , possess
4. responsible , inherent , verbal , logical
5. typically , vividly , rapidly , basically

答案:
1. investigation
2. tracking
3. possess
4. inherent
5. rapidly

sense_groups.english: The human capacity to perceive rapid alterations in visual scenes, colloquially referred to as “speed of sight”, exhibits a remarkable degree of variation among individuals, as revealed by the inaugural systematic investigation into this phenomenon.
sense_groups.chinese: 人类感知视觉场景中快速变化的能力，俗称“视觉速度”，在个体间表现出显著差异，正如首次针对这一现象的系统性研究所揭示的那样。

sense_groups.english: This variability in visual acuity may elucidate the differential aptitude observed in individuals when engaging in sports that require tracking of fast-moving objects, such as baseball and cricket.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种视觉敏锐度的差异或许可以解释个体在参与需要追踪快速移动物体的运动（如棒球和板球）时所表现出的不同能力。

sense_groups.english: The study posits that certain individuals possess an innate superior vision that enables them to follow fast-moving objects with greater precision than others.
sense_groups.chinese: 该研究认为，某些个体天生拥有更优越的视觉，使他们能够比其他人更精确地追踪快速移动的物体。

sense_groups.english: This inherent visual prowess could potentially account for the disparities observed in individuals’ performance in ball sports.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种与生俱来的视觉能力可能解释了在球类运动中个体表现出的差异。

sense_groups.english: The research, led by Clinton Haarlem at Trinity College Dublin, underscores the critical role of visual perception in our interaction with rapidly changing environments and its potential implications in the realm of sports.
sense_groups.chinese: 这项由都柏林圣三一学院的克林顿·哈勒姆领导的研究，强调了视觉感知在我们与快速变化环境互动中的关键作用，及其在体育领域的潜在影响。

questions.name: #1002 Automated Laboratories
questions.en:

In various fields of study, self-driving labs have already demonstrated their utility.

As these labs become ______ prevalent and sophisticated, they necessitate the development of new ethical and legal frameworks.

2. match , grow , accelerate , mirror
3. appearance , result , risk , process

questions.name: #1003 Jupiter
questions.en:

questions.name: #1004 YOD

Some of these factors are modifiable and/or preventable, meaning that they can be changed or avoided by ______ healthy habits.
For example, physical exercise, a Mediterranean-based diet, cognitive stimulation, mood regulation, and social interaction can all help lower the risk of YOD.
By addressing these early on, it may be possible to prevent or delay the onset of YOD and improve the ______ for the affected individuals and their families.

3. adopting , dominating , leading , varying

questions.name: #1005 Collaborative Endeavor
questions.en:

2. independence , rivalry , spirit , complexity
3. lagged , turned , paid , pushed
4. through , against , into , away

questions.name: #1006 Solar Eclipse

3. which , what , there , where

2. to add , if added , adding , by adding
3. involving , dropping , separating , eliminating
4. independent , modest , favorable , crucial

sense_groups.english: Penicillin, discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928,

sense_groups.chinese: 标志着医学科学的一场革命。

questions.en:
Evaluating the cognitive capabilities of various species is a complex ______ .
How does one measure the intelligence of a crow against that of an octopus?
Biologists utilize certain methodologies that don't require active participation from the animal.

It's also observed that ______ animals (such as felines and birds of prey) generally exhibit higher intelligence than herbivores.
This is because hunting requires complex strategies and problem-solving skills.

sense_groups.english: Evaluating the cognitive capabilities of various species is a complex endeavor .
sense_groups.chinese: 评估不同物种的认知能力是一项复杂的工作。

sense_groups.english: How does one measure the intelligence of a crow against that of an octopus?
sense_groups.chinese: 如何衡量乌鸦与章鱼的智力呢？

sense_groups.english: Biologists utilize certain methodologies that don't require active participation from the animal.
sense_groups.chinese: 生物学家使用某些不需要动物主动参与的方法。

sense_groups.english: A key indicator of intelligence is the encephalization quotient (EQ), which assesses an animal's brain size relative to its body size.
sense_groups.chinese: 智力的一个关键指标是脑化商数（EQ），它评估动物大脑相对于身体大小的比例。

sense_groups.english: This metric helps to level the playing field across species, as it accounts for differences in overall body size.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个指标有助于跨物种公平比较，因为它考虑了整体身体大小的差异。

sense_groups.english: For instance, a whale's brain is much larger than that of a cat, but this is proportionate to its massive body size.
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，鲸鱼的大脑比猫大得多，但这与其庞大的身体大小成比例。

sense_groups.english: When using the encephalization quotient, humans emerge as the most intellectually advanced, followed closely by other primates, cetaceans like dolphins and whales, and certain bird species like crows and parrots.
sense_groups.chinese: 使用脑化商数时，人类成为智力最先进的物种，紧随其后的是其他灵长类动物、鲸类（如海豚和鲸鱼）以及某些鸟类（如乌鸦和鹦鹉）。

sense_groups.english: It's also observed that predatory animals (such as felines and birds of prey) generally exhibit higher intelligence than herbivores.
sense_groups.chinese: 还观察到，捕食性动物（如猫科动物和猛禽）通常比食草动物表现出更高的智力。

sense_groups.english: This is because hunting requires complex strategies and problem-solving skills.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是因为捕猎需要复杂的策略和解决问题的能力。

questions.name: #1028 Positive Thinking

Positive thinking isn't just about expecting the best to happen; it's a concept in psychology that can have a big impact on your life.

But if you believe you can do it, you're more likely to get back up and keep trying until you can ride smoothly.
Positive thinking also has a lot to do with self-talk – the endless ______ of thoughts that run through your head every day.
Of course, being positive all the time isn't realistic.
Everyone has tough days.
The key is to try and find the ______ lining, even in difficult situations.
This doesn't mean you're ignoring the problem; it means you're looking for ways to make the best of it.

2. adventurous , suggestive , economic , optimistic
3. lane , fountain , stream , drift
4. worthy , golden , silver , perfect

sense_groups.english: This region was primarily inhabited by various tribes and groups often referred to collectively as the Celts and Germanic peoples.

questions.name: #1038 Crop Rotation
questions.en:

sense_groups.english: Without access to chemical fertilizers, medieval farmers developed and relied heavily on the system of crop rotation to preserve the health of their arable land.
sense_groups.chinese: 在没有化肥的情况下，中世纪农民开发并严重依赖轮作制度来保持耕地的健康。

sense_groups.english: This agrarian practice was essential for sustaining the ever-growing populations of medieval Europe.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种农业实践对于维持中世纪欧洲不断增长的人口至关重要。

sense_groups.english: Crop rotation involved the cyclic cultivation of different types of crops on the same plot of land over several seasons or years.
sense_groups.chinese: 轮作涉及在同一块土地上，在几个季节或几年内循环种植不同类型的作物。

sense_groups.english: This method prevented the depletion of specific soil nutrients, as different crops had varying nutrient requirements and effects on the soil composition.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种方法防止了特定土壤养分的枯竭，因为不同作物对养分需求不同，对土壤成分的影响也不同。

sense_groups.english: Typically, a farmer would plant grain crops, such as wheat or barley, which were nitrogen-consuming, in one year.
sense_groups.chinese: 通常，农民会在一年里种植谷物作物，如小麦或大麦，这些作物消耗氮。

sense_groups.english: The following year, the field would be sown with legumes like peas or beans, which had the ability to fix nitrogen back into the soil.
sense_groups.chinese: 第二年，这块地会种上豆类作物，如豌豆或蚕豆，它们能够将氮固定回土壤中。

sense_groups.english: In some rotations, the third year would involve leaving the field fallow – unplanted – to allow the land to recover naturally.
sense_groups.chinese: 在某些轮作中，第三年会让田地休耕——不种植——让土地自然恢复。

sense_groups.english: In other cases, the fallow land would be used for grazing livestock, which helped in manure deposition, further enriching the soil.
sense_groups.chinese: 在其他情况下，休耕地会被用来放牧牲畜，这有助于粪便沉积，进一步肥沃土壤。

sense_groups.english: However, delving deeper reveals a complex environmental quandary.

questions.name: #1056 Disposable Cups

However, the turn of the century marked the onset of a grave environmental ______ .

The vibrant underwater communities dwindled, leading to a dramatic fall in tourist arrivals and a subsequent economic downturn for the town.
The stark decline served as a grim ______ of the fragile interdependence between human activities and natural ecosystems.

1. climate , vision , haven , notion
2. priority , inflation , influx , utility
3. crisis , status , prohibition , criterion
4. domain , policy , reminder , exaggeration

questions.name: #1079 Heart Disease
questions.en:
Heart disease is the number one killer in the US, but many people don’t know the signs or how to ______ it.
Heart disease is a term for different problems that affect the heart or blood vessels, such as blocked arteries, irregular heartbeats, or birth defects.

3. far , just , right , soon
4. curbing , losing , cutting , opting
5. finding , staying , bringing , acting

questions.name: #1080 Space Cuisine
questions.en:

However, the ______ for sustainable long-term space habitation has sparked innovation in space cuisine.
Advanced hydroponic systems and bioregenerative life support systems are being developed to enable the cultivation of fresh ______ in microgravity conditions.

questions.name: #1081 Sleep Habbits
questions.en:
Sleep is essential for health and well-being, but many Americans do not get ______ of it.
This problem may start as early as childhood, especially for racial and ethnic minorities, according to a study led by Julio Fernandez-Mendoza, a professor of psychiatry and behavioral health at Penn State Health.
The study followed 700 children, ages 5 to 12, for seven years and found that Black children were seven times less likely than white children to develop good sleep habits, ______ ______ socioeconomic status.
The researchers ______ this disparity to racism, stress and discrimination, which may affect children’s ability to fall and stay asleep.
They also found that poor sleep in childhood persisted into adolescence and adulthood, increasing the risk of chronic health conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes and obesity.
The findings suggest that sleep disparities are not only a consequence but also a ______ of social and health inequities.
The researchers called for more awareness and intervention to promote sleep health among minority children and families, as well as policies to address the structural ______ of poor sleep.
1. necessary , such , enough , sufficient
2. compared to , no matter , nevertheless , regardless of
3. preserved , disclosed , separated , attributed
4. pivot , cause , progression , result
5. stems , deterrents , determinants , symbols
questions.answer:
1. enough
2. regardless
3. of
4. attributed
5. cause
6. determinants

Sleep is essential for health and well-being, but many Americans do not get ______ of it.
This problem may start as early as childhood, especially for racial and ethnic minorities, according to a study led by Julio Fernandez-Mendoza, a professor of psychiatry and behavioral health at Penn State Health.

sense_groups.english: Sleep is essential for health and well-being, but many Americans do not get enough of it.
sense_groups.chinese: 睡眠对健康和幸福至关重要，但许多美国人睡眠不足。

sense_groups.english: This problem may start as early as childhood, especially for racial and ethnic minorities, according to a study led by Julio Fernandez-Mendoza, a professor of psychiatry and behavioral health at Penn State Health.
sense_groups.chinese: 根据宾夕法尼亚州立大学健康学院精神病学和行为健康教授胡里奥·费尔南德斯-门多萨领导的一项研究，这个问题可能早在童年时期就开始出现，尤其是对种族和族裔少数群体而言。

sense_groups.english: The study followed 700 children, ages 5 to 12, for seven years and found that Black children were seven times less likely than white children to develop good sleep habits, regardless of socioeconomic status.
sense_groups.chinese: 这项研究对700名5至12岁的儿童进行了为期七年的跟踪调查，发现无论社会经济地位如何，黑人儿童养成良好睡眠习惯的可能性比白人儿童低七倍。

sense_groups.english: The researchers attributed this disparity to racism, stress and discrimination, which may affect children’s ability to fall and stay asleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 研究人员将这种差异归因于种族主义、压力和歧视，这些因素可能会影响儿童入睡和保持睡眠的能力。

sense_groups.english: They also found that poor sleep in childhood persisted into adolescence and adulthood, increasing the risk of chronic health conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes and obesity.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们还发现，儿童时期的睡眠问题会持续到青春期和成年期，增加患心血管疾病、糖尿病和肥胖等慢性健康问题的风险。

sense_groups.english: The findings suggest that sleep disparities are not only a consequence but also a cause of social and health inequities.
sense_groups.chinese: 研究结果表明，睡眠差异不仅是社会与健康不平等的结果，也是其原因之一。

sense_groups.english: The researchers called for more awareness and intervention to promote sleep health among minority children and families, as well as policies to address the structural determinants of poor sleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 研究人员呼吁提高认识并进行干预，以促进少数族裔儿童和家庭的睡眠健康，同时制定政策解决导致睡眠不良的结构性决定因素。

questions.name: #1082 Existentialism
questions.en:
Existentialism is a philosophical movement that became prominent in the 20th century, particularly in the years ______ World War II.
At its core, existentialism emphasizes the individual human being’s freedom and responsibility to give meaning to their own life.
Key existentialist philosophers like Jean-Paul Sartre and Kierkegaard argued for the primacy of existence over essence.
This means they believed that human beings define themselves through the choices they ______ and the actions they take, rather than having some ______ essence or nature that defines who they are.
As Sartre famously stated, “existence precedes essence.” This focus on subjective experience and individual freedom leads to the existentialist view that each person must create meaning for themselves in an objectively meaningless and absurd universe.
Existentialists do not believe there is any ______ meaning or purpose given by a divine being or human nature - there is only the meaning we each generate.
This places the ______ and responsibility of making choices and directing one’s life solely on the individual.
1. next , following , posting , hereafter
2. give , set , make , take
3. methodological , predetermined , adequate , transient
4. bulky , incidental , overarching , conditional
5. spectacle , echo , burden , career

sense_groups.english: Existentialists do not believe there is any overarching meaning or purpose given by a divine being or human nature - there is only the meaning we each generate.
sense_groups.chinese: 存在主义者不相信有任何由神或人性赋予的总体意义或目的——只有我们每个人自己产生的意义。

questions.name: #1083 Diet Trends

The introduction of agriculture was a turning point, leading to the development of settlements and the ______ of civilizations.
Nowadays, there's a significant ______ in diets like paleo, which suggest eating similarly to our ancestors for better health, highlighting a debate on the impact of processed foods.

4. basically , locally , local , basic

sense_groups.english: And it's not just humans that fall victim to the mosquito's deadly embrace.

sense_groups.english: Wildlife, livestock, and even beloved household pets
sense_groups.chinese: 野生动物、家畜甚至心爱的家庭宠物

sense_groups.english: From birds to elephants,
sense_groups.chinese: 从鸟类到大象

questions.name: #1090 Fire
questions.en:
In the early chapters of human history, nestled under giant trees and beneath the vast sky, humans ______ on the edge of a major change.

This ______ over a wild element of nature marked a new chapter, lighting up the dark corners of existence and bringing warmth to the chilly, uncertain world our ancestors walked through.
Before fire came into the picture, nightfall meant danger and ______ .
It was when predators with sharp eyes roamed, and fear filled human hearts.
Life was ruled by daylight, and the disappearance of the sun meant hiding away in whatever ______ was available.
But learning to create and control fire changed all that.
Campfires turned into safe spots and gathering places, where stories took shape, traditions were born, and the first communities were formed.
1. wandered , thought , stood , lay
2. control , share , confusion , invention
3. gill , lure , feat , fear
4. zone , horizon , aspect , shelter

sense_groups.english: In the early chapters of human history, nestled under giant trees and beneath the vast sky, humans stood on the edge of a major change.
sense_groups.chinese: 在人类历史的早期篇章中，依偎在巨树之下和广阔天空之下，人类站在重大变革的边缘。

sense_groups.english: The discovery of fire was like a spark that set off a huge shift in how early humans lived, thought, and evolved.
sense_groups.chinese: 火的发现就像一颗火花，引发了早期人类生活、思考和进化方式的巨大转变。

sense_groups.english: This control over a wild element of nature marked a new chapter, lighting up the dark corners of existence and bringing warmth to the chilly, uncertain world our ancestors walked through.
sense_groups.chinese: 对这种自然野性元素的掌控标志着一个新篇章，照亮了存在的黑暗角落，并为我们祖先走过的寒冷、不确定的世界带来了温暖。

sense_groups.english: Before fire came into the picture, nightfall meant danger and fear.
sense_groups.chinese: 在火出现之前，夜幕降临意味着危险和恐惧。

sense_groups.english: It was when predators with sharp eyes roamed, and fear filled human hearts.
sense_groups.chinese: 那是目光锐利的捕食者游荡的时候，恐惧充满了人类的心。

sense_groups.english: Life was ruled by daylight, and the disappearance of the sun meant hiding away in whatever shelter was available.
sense_groups.chinese: 生活由日光主宰，太阳的消失意味着躲进任何可用的庇护所。

sense_groups.english: But learning to create and control fire changed all that.
sense_groups.chinese: 但学会创造和控制火改变了这一切。

sense_groups.english: Campfires turned into safe spots and gathering places, where stories took shape, traditions were born, and the first communities were formed.
sense_groups.chinese: 篝火变成了安全地点和聚集场所，故事在这里成形，传统在这里诞生，最初的社区在这里形成。

questions.name: #1091 Street Photography
questions.en:
Imagine weaving through the city's concrete jungle, camera in hand.
You're not just a tourist catching selfies, you're a street photographer, hunting for raw moments and telling the city's story.
But this chase comes with its own set of ______ .
First, there are the legal hoops.
Privacy laws and copyright rules can trip you up fast.
Asking for permission, especially when emotions run high, requires tact and respect.
It's a constant balance between capturing the real and respecting ______ .
Tech, while handy, throws its own curveballs.
The flood of images online makes standing out tough.
Finding your unique voice, cutting through the noise, and making your work ______ takes constant reinvention and self-reflection.
So, the next time you see a photographer navigating the urban maze, remember the challenges they face.
Their lens is a window into the city's heartbeat, capturing fleeting moments that would ______ be lost.
Respect their dedication, for they are the storytellers of the streets, preserving the ever-evolving story of life on the streets.
1. bundles , puddles , hurdles , huddles
2. backgrounds , boundaries , edges , shallows
3. prove , matter , falter , encroach
4. except , so far , otherwise , despite

sense_groups.english: Imagine weaving through the city's concrete jungle, camera in hand.

sense_groups.english: You're not just a tourist catching selfies, you're a street photographer, hunting for raw moments and telling the city's story.

sense_groups.english: But this chase comes with its own set of hurdles.

sense_groups.english: So, the next time you see a photographer navigating the urban maze, remember the challenges they face.

sense_groups.english: Respect their dedication, for they are the storytellers of the streets, preserving the ever-evolving story of life on the streets.
sense_groups.chinese: 尊重他们的奉献，因为他们是街头故事的讲述者，保存着街头生活不断演变的故事。

questions.name: #1092 Moon Landing
questions.en:
Since the last footprints were pressed into the moon's dust by Apollo 17 in 1972, no one has returned.
This pause in moon landings isn't about lost interest or technology, ______ a complex mix of reasons reshaping our journey in space.
Back in the 60s and 70s, the moon was a stage for a cosmic competition, with the USA and Soviet Union locked in a space race.
Once the Apollo missions ______ that win for the USA, the urgency faded.
The moon had been reached; the point was proven.
With that box ticked, the ______ costs of moon missions — running into billions — started to weigh heavily.
Questions arose: Was it worth spending so much to send more astronauts to the moon?
As the 70s rolled on, priorities shifted.
The space shuttle program, promising reusable spacecraft, and robotic explorers venturing to Mars and beyond seemed more appealing and ______ .
These missions promised fresh knowledge and possibly new technologies, without the staggering price tag of manned lunar visits.
1. while , but , hence , so
2. climbed , clinched , ached , pinched
3. supplementary , differential , prohibitive , professional
4. practical , conceptual , terminal , preliminary

Since the last footprints were pressed into the moon's dust by Apollo 17 in 1972, no one has returned.
This pause in moon landings isn't about lost interest or technology, ______ a complex mix of reasons reshaping our journey in space.

sense_groups.english: Since the last footprints were pressed into the moon's dust by Apollo 17 in 1972, no one has returned.
sense_groups.chinese: 自1972年阿波罗17号在月球尘埃上留下最后脚印以来，再无人返回。

sense_groups.english: This pause in moon landings isn't about lost interest or technology,
sense_groups.chinese: 登月暂停并非因为兴趣或技术丧失，

sense_groups.english: but a complex mix of reasons reshaping our journey in space.
sense_groups.chinese: 而是重塑我们太空之旅的复杂原因交织。

sense_groups.english: Back in the 60s and 70s, the moon was a stage for a cosmic competition,

sense_groups.chinese: 美苏深陷太空竞赛。

sense_groups.english: Once the Apollo missions clinched that win for the USA, the urgency faded.
sense_groups.chinese: 一旦阿波罗任务为美国锁定胜局，紧迫感便消退。

sense_groups.english: The moon had been reached; the point was proven.
sense_groups.chinese: 月球已抵达；论点已证明。

sense_groups.english: With that box ticked, the prohibitive costs of moon missions — running into billions — started to weigh heavily.
sense_groups.chinese: 完成这一目标后，登月任务的巨额成本——高达数十亿——开始沉重压顶。

sense_groups.english: Questions arose: Was it worth spending so much to send more astronauts to the moon?
sense_groups.chinese: 疑问浮现：花费巨资送更多宇航员登月是否值得？

sense_groups.english: As the 70s rolled on, priorities shifted.
sense_groups.chinese: 随着70年代推进，优先级转变。

sense_groups.english: The space shuttle program, promising reusable spacecraft, and robotic explorers venturing to Mars and beyond seemed more appealing and practical.

sense_groups.english: These missions promised fresh knowledge and possibly new technologies, without the staggering price tag of manned lunar visits.
sense_groups.chinese: 这些任务承诺新知识和可能的新技术，而无需载人登月那惊人的代价。

questions.name: #1093 Sign Languages
questions.en:
Evidence suggests ancient Egyptians and Greeks used hand gestures to supplement communication.
Yet, it wasn't ______ the 17th century in Europe that formal sign languages began to flourish.
Institutions for the deaf ______ , and with them, educators like Charles-Michel de l'Épée in France, who developed systems using manual alphabets and gestures.
Like languages spoken, sign languages diversified.
American Sign Language (ASL), for instance, branched out from French Sign Language, carrying echoes of its European cousin but forging its own ______ identity.
This evolution wasn't confined to geography.
Within communities, nuances emerged, reflecting regional dialects and cultural experiences.
Deaf communities thrived, stories weaving through generations, jokes punctuated by laughter translated into expressive movements.
However, the ______ wasn't paved with only sunshine.
The 19th century saw the rise of oralism, a push to prioritize spoken language for the deaf.
Sign languages were deemed inferior, relegating them to the shadows.
Thankfully, the pendulum swung back.
The late 20th century ______ a resurgence of sign languages, recognized as complete and complex systems with rich grammar and expressive power.
1. until , from , onto , at
2. declined , converged , repaired , emerged
3. unique , necessary , primary , common
4. exploration , subject , signal , path
5. mentored , gained , witnessed , distributed
questions.full:
Evidence suggests ancient Egyptians and Greeks used hand gestures to supplement communication.

sense_groups.english: Evidence suggests ancient Egyptians and Greeks used hand gestures to supplement communication.
sense_groups.chinese: 证据表明，古埃及人和希腊人使用手势来辅助交流。

sense_groups.english: Yet, it wasn't until the 17th century in Europe that formal sign languages began to flourish.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，直到17世纪的欧洲，正式的手语才开始蓬勃发展。

sense_groups.english: Institutions for the deaf emerged, and with them, educators like Charles-Michel de l'Épée in France, who developed systems using manual alphabets and gestures.
sense_groups.chinese: 聋人机构出现了，随之而来的是像法国的夏尔-米歇尔·德·莱佩这样的教育家，他们开发了使用手语字母和手势的系统。

sense_groups.english: Like languages spoken, sign languages diversified.
sense_groups.chinese: 像口语一样，手语也变得多样化。

sense_groups.english: American Sign Language (ASL), for instance, branched out from French Sign Language, carrying echoes of its European cousin but forging its own unique identity.
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，美国手语从法国手语分支出来，带有其欧洲表亲的影子，但形成了自己独特的身份。

sense_groups.english: This evolution wasn't confined to geography.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种演变并不局限于地理。

sense_groups.english: Within communities, nuances emerged, reflecting regional dialects and cultural experiences.
sense_groups.chinese: 在社区内部，细微差别出现了，反映了地区方言和文化经验。

sense_groups.english: Deaf communities thrived, stories weaving through generations, jokes punctuated by laughter translated into expressive movements.
sense_groups.chinese: 聋人社区蓬勃发展，故事代代相传，笑声点缀的笑话转化为富有表现力的动作。

sense_groups.english: However, the path wasn't paved with only sunshine.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，这条路并非只有阳光。

sense_groups.english: The 19th century saw the rise of oralism, a push to prioritize spoken language for the deaf.
sense_groups.chinese: 19世纪见证了口语主义的兴起，即优先考虑聋人口语的推动。

sense_groups.english: Sign languages were deemed inferior, relegating them to the shadows.
sense_groups.chinese: 手语被认为低人一等，被边缘化。

sense_groups.english: Thankfully, the pendulum swung back.
sense_groups.chinese: 幸运的是，钟摆又摆回来了。

sense_groups.english: The late 20th century witnessed a resurgence of sign languages, recognized as complete and complex systems with rich grammar and expressive power.
sense_groups.chinese: 20世纪末，手语复兴，被公认为具有丰富语法和表达力的完整复杂系统。

questions.name: #1094 Bird Legs
questions.en:
One of the reasons why bird legs seem so thin is that their body is largely hidden by feathers, which can make them look much bigger than they really are.
Birds have more muscular thighs that are ______ by their feathers, and most birds have scaly skin on their lower legs, which makes these parts look very small and bare.
Birds that have feathers ______ ______ ______ to their toes — such as owls and some breeds of chickens — seem to have thicker calves than their featherless-legged relatives.
But it’s not only a matter of perception: bird legs have some real differences from legs of other living animals.
Birds are the descendants of theropod dinosaurs, a group of animals that walked on two legs and varied in size.
  ______ most mammals that can walk on two legs — such as bears, chimpanzees and humans—who stand on their heels, dinosaurs walked on their toes and the front part of the foot, with the rest of their foot bones stretched and lifted off the ______ .
Living birds inherited some of these features.
However, as birds became more adapted to flying, they also developed some distinct ______ .
1. bordered , shared , covered , detailed
2. at the end , all the way , all in all , just above
3. Because of , Whereas , Unlike , As
4. air , tip , ground , platform
5. figures , colors , traits , volumes

2. all
3. the
4. way
5. Unlike
6. ground

questions.name: #1095 Satellite
questions.en:

sense_groups.english: Ibn Khaldun was a scholar from North Africa born in the 14th century.
sense_groups.chinese: 伊本·赫勒敦是一位14世纪出生于北非的学者。

sense_groups.english: He is most renowned for his work "Muqaddimah," where he laid out the foundations of several social sciences.
sense_groups.chinese: 他最著名的作品是《历史绪论》，在其中他奠定了多个社会科学的基础。

sense_groups.english: Khaldun challenged how history was recorded, arguing that it should be based on societal trends and common patterns, not just stories of leaders and battles.
sense_groups.chinese: 赫勒敦挑战了历史记录的方式，主张历史应基于社会趋势和普遍模式，而不仅仅是领袖和战争的故事。

sense_groups.chinese: 他引入了诸如“Asabiyyah”（社会凝聚力）等概念，并讨论了经济和社会如何随时间演变。

sense_groups.english: Khaldun's ideas were ahead of their time, influencing not just the Islamic world but also later European thinkers.
sense_groups.chinese: 赫勒敦的思想超前于时代，不仅影响了伊斯兰世界，也影响了后来的欧洲思想家。

sense_groups.chinese: 尽管他的著作范围广泛，伊本·赫勒敦在主流历史叙述中并不像他的一些同时代人或后继者那样广为人知，

questions.name: #1108 Time Travel
questions.en:
Time travel is a popular theme in science fiction, but can it also be a useful tool in quantum physics?

The researchers propose a scenario in ______ an experimentalist wants to measure the strength of an unknown interaction using a quantum probe.
